data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Sqedceḍ aselmed amezwaru deg Satisfactory ̇s Server Manager, ad teṭṭfeḍ amseqdac s -NewConsole.
Ɛeddi-d ddaw-a. Synix yettceggɛa tmeslayt-nni, yeɣra taggayt-nni tamaynut, yettwaḥeqqeḍ-tt, yerna teffer-itt s tɣellist. Ur d-yettwakki ara neɣ ur d-yettaṭṭaf ara.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Taɣect-nni ttuɣa, maca Synix ur yezmir ara ad d-yerr yiwen n uḍris amaynut seg usebter-a. Ẓer ma yella ad d-yerr uselkim-is yerna ad d-yettaru. Yella kra n tlelli i d-yettwaḥrez; Ur yettnadi ara seg tikkelt nniḍen.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Yebda s tɣawla 1. Ẓer isem n uḍar akk-d AppID n useqdec n Steam. 2. Ad d-ternu abrid n umseqdac i yettwaxeddmen ɣef uḍar n umseqdac i d-yessersen. 3. Ẓer kan anaru n uselmed i d-iteddun deffir uselmed. Sseqdec isekkilen i yettwaɛǧeben ddaw-a anda ilaq ad d-yesseqdec Synix amḍiq n umseqdac. 4. Xdem amek i d-yettunefk uḍar amaru-ines. Taɣawsa n uselmed teḥwaǧ ad d-teddun amaru n umennuɣ yeṣfan, mačči d amedya n temsalt. 5. Select Validate & Preview. Sseḥbel yal ugur i d-yettmeslayen uqbel ad tesellek. 6. Sellek, rnu-d Synix, xeddmet tiɣriwin iɛezzin, dɣa ttɛerḍemt asmi ara d-tessnulfuḍ/tessnulfuḍ/tḥebseḍ/tḥebseḍ n wurar.
IWILEN YIWILEN • Isem n wurar: isem i d-yettwalin imseqdacen deg Synix. • ID n tsekla: ID n tsekla tamecṭuḥt; Synix yefka-t-id seg yisem n wurar. • Steam AppID: AppID n useqdec, mačči dima AppID n ccna n umdan. • SteamCMD app configuration: normally blank. Iɣilen i d-yeddun GoldSrc AppID 90 ttqeddmen tifyar yettwaḥeqqaren "90 mod folder", am "90 mod cstrike". Synix yeqbel kan amedya- agi. • Yettwaxedmen: amedya Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Ur tesɛiḍ ara taserdast n usekles. • Tiddukla: tiddukla n uḍar d tiddukla n temsalt i yettwaḥdem. • Tameẓra d tilelliyin n wurar: tseddmeḍ yiwet n tgeldi n wurar ssebba. Tiɣriwin-agi ttemlilen tiferwiyin i d-yettbanen mi ara d-tessnulfu neɣ ad d-tesbeddu yiwen n uselkim.
ARGUMENTA n usebtar Ur d-teddim ara ɣer tmeslayt-nni s yiman-is. Ḥadret isekkilen n wurar am uḍris amecṭuḥ yerna tsers-d isekkilen kan i yizerfan yettwaḥkemen s Synix. Amedya: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
TAGES-IN D-YEBBEN [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Rnu-d {rcon} deg tmeslayin n usebter anda i d-yeqqen uḍris RCON. deg RCON syntax, use: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Example RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
TAMURT n uselmed • Mazal ur yettwaḥeqqeq ara: Synix ur yettḥaddam ara adlis n uselkim. • Tameɣra t-id-tnulfa mi d-tekka tikelt tamezwarut: tesseqdec amḍal n umezgun yettwaṭṭfen akk-d asmel n uḥeddar d uḥeddar. • Synix yettwaxleq-it seg yiwen n usebter: Synix yessers aselkem akk uqbel ad d-yeldi tazwara. • Taɣawsiwin n useqdec kan: ur ttwaḥwaǧ ara ad d-yettunefk yiwen n uselkim yettwaselmen i usebter-agi.
TEMPLATE TAGS CONFIGURATION {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} yettaru azal n tidet n tsekla mi yella wawal n uselkim n uselkim, d azal-is n lekdeb mi yella wawal n uselkim ulac. Seqdec Add configuration files m'ara yeḥwaǧ uqeddac ugar n yiwen ufaylu. Ffer yal afaylu agejdan s lekmal-is, syin beddel amkan-is yettwasbedden deg uḍebsi akken abrid ad yili d win n ufaylu n uqeddac. Synix yessawaḍ, yessekcem, yettaru, yettqeɛɛid, yerna yesnerni yal afaylu i d-yettwasekren.
FILES RECORDED BY USER-supplied Ssebded yiwen n ubrid aman ɣef yiwet n tegrawla, deg umata n useqqamu n uselkim i d-yessersen. Isebtaren i yellan ddaw-a sɛan aseɣwen: D isefra i d-yettunefkan mi d-tafent, maca werǧin ttḥebsen awal. Ma d ifaylen i yettwaḥwaǧen i d-yekkan seg urar n umezgun amecṭuḥ, ssefhem yal talɣa n umseqdac deg uselmed n useqdec. Synix ur d-yettunefkar ara, ur yeǧǧi ara tagnit, neɣ ur d-yessufuɣ ara ifayel n imurar i yesɛan tezmert. Aḍris n yed yedrimen i d-yettunefken, d isem n uḍris Synix yezmer ad yettnadi deg uḍris n Documents n umseqdac. Eǧǧ-it d azref mi ilaq ad yeqbel umseqdac idlisen s ufus.
Aḥebbar amezwaru d ICON Sseqdec-d tmusni mi ara d-yekkren imseqdacen tawsit uqbel ad d-yeffeɣ amezwaru. Aru-d tiɣriwin i d-yettunefken akken ad d-yernu ayen akk ilaq ad t-yefk umseqdac seg uḍar-is n urar. URL n usemmiḍ d tiferrit yerna ilaq ad yesqedceḍ HTTPS. Synix yeqqel ɣer usefru n umseqdac i d-yettunefken mi ara d-yeffɣen.
TAMURT D TAMURT Ibda isebtaren d isebtaren imaynuten di revizion 1. Aṭas n usebter n tmusni m'ara tbeddel tmusni n wurar. Ad d-yekkes amedya n usebter kan mi ara ibeddel usebter n umennuɣ i yettwaḥkem. Synix yugi-d ad d-yessufeɣ ma ur d-yettwassen ara ugar, yerna yettḥerrez tiɣriwin n umagrad.
OPTION POST-INSTALL Asebtar Steam n tikli n usebter kan mi d-yessken ad t-yeḥwaǧ umseqdac. Ilaq ad yili d aɣbel n tlelli i d-yekkan deg usebter n uselkim-nni. Synix tekker-d kan tlata n yisekkilen-is Steam DLLs n uswir.
Iḥwaǧen n tallit Ssebba n uḥric azzenz RAM ɣer 0 mi ur tesɛi ara uḥric azzenz. Hardware d Windows- tiḥeṛṛibin n teswiɛt i d-yettbanen ɣef kra n wayen i d-yeǧǧan uqerruy uqbel ad d-yesseqdec, yerna ttwaḥebsen asfel ur nelli ara yeṣfan; ur beddlent ara iseddin n Windows. Select a .NET Framework neɣ Visual C++ tikelt n usebter kan mi ara t-id-yefken kra n yiswiyen n wurar. Synix yettɛessas amaruz n Windows maca ur d-yettunefki ara neɣ ur d-yettunefki ara s tsusmi. Hyper-V yeḥwaǧ Windows Professional neɣ ugar, dɣa ma d-tefrun Hyper-V, ad tefrun daɣen ayen i d-yeḥwaǧ Windows.
TAMURT n usebter Sseqdec-d uḍebsi n uḍebsi amaynut i uselkimen i d-yefkan. Taɣawsa tazelda d tin n usebter, n tmacint tazelda neɣ n tdukli-nniḍen i yesɛan umennuɣ n tudert n useqdec; yettḥebbes s ttawil n uḍebsi n teqsiṭ. Ssebba n uselkim yettwaḥwaǧen yettbanen i urar ay yessefk ad yeqqim d amedyaz n uselkim uselkim. D aya i d-yeǧǧan ad d-yekkes lbaṭel n useqdac deg umaḍal n tmeslayin n usekles n umezruy, ɣas ɣef usemmiḍ-nni. Yettwaḥseb-d usebter n tmeslayin n .exe, .bat, d .cmd kan. Asebtar n ussexdamu n usefru n usebter kan mi yezmer umseqdac ad d-yebdi d ad yessexdem usefru n usebter n usebter i yettwasemmaren di beṛṛa n Synix. Asebtar-nni yeṣfan yettban-d mi d-yessaweḍ uḍar-nni n usebter. Timura-yagi ttarun tikli n Synix i d-yettunefkan, ur zmiren ara ad rnun iskripten neɣ tifeṛḍin i d-yettunefken.
DISCOVERY LOG Ssekcem-d iberdan n tɣellist ɣef ufaylu-nni n uqeddac yettwaseklesen. Seqdec * i yiwen n uḥric n webrid neɣ isem n ufaylu akked ** i isefka yeqqnen. Tiɣriwin n umkan i yettwaḥerzen d {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, akked {QueryPort}. Imedyazen: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix yettnadi iberdan-agi kan mi d-yeqqar umseqdac ad yeffeḍ taggayt tamaynut n wurar.

data.name: Text.ED08E4C207A6FC2493D7
data.value: ◇ Iḍan iḥulfan ddun ɣef uselmed n useqdec n tɣellist Synix.

data.name: Text.4234688FB477D9CF1421
data.value: ◇ Isebtaren i d-yettbanen: Tiɣriwin ur nelli ara tt-id-yeǧǧan ad t-id-ternu deg urar i yettwassnen.

data.name: Text.1B0142C80D27A3442046
data.value: ⚠ Tbeddil n umkan-agi ur t-yeffɣer ara tiɣriwin n uḍris seg useqdec amezwaru.

data.name: Text.A9B62C4456D11AE0550C
data.value: 🔒 [REQUIRED] Ad d-ternu isem n uselkim dɣa ad d-ternu Tameẓra n wurar.

data.name: Text.1A759326BD5A56996BF1
data.value: 1 Isebtar-ik ad yeqqim yezga Isebtaren, isebtaren, tiɣriwin n uḍebsi, lweqt n usebter, d SteamCMD ttwaḥerzen ddaw C:\Synix, dɣa tiɣriwin n useqdec ur ten-id-yettawi ara.

data.name: Text.CD33F03B524794FFF78C
data.value: 2 Add A SERVER Xdem yiwet n tturart, tseddmeḍ tiɣriwin n tdukli, dɣa ǧǧet Synix ad tt-yessers. Steam login yettwaḥwaǧ kan mi ttwaḥwaǧen ccɣel-nni.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: 3 START, STOP, AND VERIFY Synix d-yettban timsirin n usebtu n usebtu, yettwaḥeqqeǧ awal, yettqeddim tikli n usebtu anda i tt-id-yettunefk, yerna yeṭṭef tiɣriwin i d-yeffɣen seg zik.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: 4 NETWORK ACCESS Windows Isebtaren n Firewall d usebter n tmeslayt n tmeslayt n tmeslayt, llan yemgaraden. Synix yettɛeṭṭef imennuɣ n wemkan, maca werǧin ibeddel amseddar-ik.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: 5 RECOVERY AND BACKUPS Seqdaceḍ-d "Settings" > "Advanced" > "Troubleshooter" i useḥbiber d useggem n tɣellist. Seqdec "Backups" uqbel ad tgeḍ Synix neɣ ad txedmeḍ ibeddlen imeqranen.

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Isem n uselmed, mačči d isem n usmel-ik Steam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Ɣur-d akk isebtaren nniḍen i d-yeḥwaǧen urar. Eddem amkan yettunefken akken yal abrid ad d-yeqqen ɣer useqdec n uselkim yettunefken.

data.name: Text.1B1883FE46A693283181
data.value: Ad d-yeǧǧ ad d-yessufu amḍiq n usebtar

data.value: Aselmed n usebded d isekkilen i yettwaḥkem

data.value: Ttxil-d tiɣriwin n usebter, ifaylen n uselkim, tiɣriwin, isekkilen, Firewall n Windows, amḍiq n diski, tiɣriwin i d-yeqqimen, imḍebsiyen i d-yedduklen, akked usebter n usebter n Synix seg yiwen n wemkan.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Ẓer SteamCMD i yimaynuten uqbel ad d-tesseqdec uselkim.

data.value: Ttxil-d SteamCMD, iswiyen n usebter, idlisen n umseqdac, tiɣriwin, ijjanen, Firewall Windows, amḍiq n diski, iswiyen i d-yeqqimen, iswiyen i d-yedduklen, akked usebter n usebter.

data.value: Ad d-tesseqdec uselkim n Minecraft i d-yettwassen da. Ḥebseḍ-t uqbel ad tbeddleḍ idlisen, igenniwen, isekkilen, neɣ tallit. Sseqdec, ḥebseḍ, u tesnulf-d tikelt-nni n tɣellist n tudert n Synix.

MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Asebtar amaynut i wakken ad twaliḍ ismawen deg Internet d yismawen n uḍebsi yettwaḥrez. Select or type a player name, then review the action. Isebtaren i sɛan azday d uselkim n tmeslayt. Bedrock ur d-yettwaṭṭef ara tiɣriwin n uḥeddar n Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Edit server.properties d mod/plugin ifayles n umennuɣ. Isebtaren i sɛan azday Synix ttwaqqen ma yella server.properties yettwasellek. Isem i d-yettunefkaren / MOTD yettwaḥesben seg yisem n umkan-agi. Refresh yessawal-d tiktiwin n usebter i d-yettwakksen seg beṛṛa ma yella yeqqel.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Ad d-yessefkeḍ ad d-yexdem tikliwin i d-yettwakksen. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tameẓla" Minecraft Isebtaren i sɛan azday Synix. JSON, XML, and YAML are analysed before saving; tiɣriwin nniḍen teḥwaǧen ad tt-tgezzin s tɣawla. Ɣur-ak tiɣriwin-ik d tidett.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer taggayt "ZIP" n Java neɣ Bedrock di yiwet n tfaska tamaynut, dɣa nefk-it akken ad tt-teqdec. Tiɣremin yellan ur ttwaṭṭfen ara amkan-nsen.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Isebtaren n JAR Metadata d tiɣawsiwin, xeddmen add-ons isebtaren, neɣ rnun taserdast n useqdec ameqqran. Sseqdec-d tikli n wurar n uḍar akk-d usebter. Tiɣriwin n umennuɣ d tin i d-yettunefken, ur d-sbegginen ara ma yella uḍris yettbanen neɣ ma yella yal modi ad ixdem.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren imeqqranen" Ḥebseḍ aselkim amezwaru. Ẓer taḥeqqt-ik uqbel ad d-ternuḍ. Asnulfu yesbeddel ifaylen n uselkim; Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Yal abeddel n unamek yeṭṭef-d tifaylin d isekkilen ineggura. Ffer-d abeddel yettwafernen neɣ yettwaḥebsen akken ad t-id-tɛawdeḍ. Zwir asebded n ibeddlen imaynuten. Isekkilen yettwabeddlen seg berra d umaḍal yettwaḥerzen yettwaḥerzen. Ṭṭef-d aseɣwen n tuqqna i usnerni n wakud n useḥbiber.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Ẓer ɣef wuguren i d-yekkan deg uḍris n uselkim n uselkim uḍris-nni i d-yewwin. Ayen i d-yefkan d isefra, mačči d isebbawen i d-yesseknen. Process CPU/RAM is not Minecraft TPS/MSPT; ssebba n usebter i d-yettunefken deg uselkim mi ara d-tessekcem usebter n usebter.

data.value: Ad d-nerni tikelt n wurar i d-yefren, ad d-ternu, ad d-nerni seg yiberdan-nsen imeqqranen? Aya yezmer ad d-yekkes Java yerna ad d-tesseḥḍu taserdast Forge/NeoForge asekkil. Isebtaren i sɛan azday amezwaru; Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " Iddunen d yigerdan ttwaḥerzen. Sseqdec-d asebtar amaynut uqbel ad tbeddleḍ tifiratin n wurar. Yiwen ur d-yessuffu amseqdac n wurar.

Synix tettafeḍ imeslayen n yimeddukal di daxel n yimedyazen yeṣfanen, yettwaɣalen, neɣ yeṭṭfen aṭas n yimeddukal, yerna tesseggim ID-s n CurseForge-nsen akken ad ttwalin. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer taggara" ASA CurseForge i d-yeffɣen ur ttbanen ara.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Sseqdec asebter-a akken ad d-tnulfuḍ aserwer-ik amezwaru. Synix yettxeddem-it deg uselkim-a, ihi fkeḍ-as-d aselkim-nni akken llan medden yetturar. Ur teḥwaǧeḍ ara ad taruḍ taggayt n tmeslayt i usebter amaynut.
1. Ff-d Synix dɣa ad tzemrem aseqdec n tsertit SteamCMD. 2. Select Add Server, then create a new server. Ma llan yakan ifaylen n uselkim, ḍfer Import Existing Server. 3. Deg General, tseddmeḍ isem n umseqdac amaynut, nefṛemt urar. Select the edition, game version, or loader if those choices appear. 4. Ḥadret tiɣriwin i d-yefkan ala ma tebɣiḍ kra nniḍen. Ẓer isebtar n uselmed i d-yeǧǧan, u rnu-d awal n uselmed yettwaḥwaǧen s ufella. 5. Select Save Server. D aya i d-yesseknen yiwet n tefyirt i usebter; Ur d-yefki ara belli urar-nni yeččuṛ. 6. Ffer asebter-nni, dɣa xtiṛ Bdu. Ǧǧet ad ifakk usekles d usebded amezwaru, ḍefṛet ayen ara d-yini Synix. 7. Sqedceḍ ayen akk i d-yefkan urar-is, am ugemmay, asmel n uselmed, neɣ ad ternuḍ tagnit deg umenzu n uḍar-is deg urar. 8. Ɣer uselkim-a neɣ deg uḍebsiḍen nniḍen n tdukli-inek. Mi ara d-yexdem waya, ssebbu-d asebtar uqbel ad ternuḍ modification neɣ ad tesbedduḍ timeddukal meqqren.
Ma yella teṭṭfeḍ Abrid Tayunt i uselkim yettwaferren, ul Activity & Diagnostics. Sseqdec amḍal-nni n tuccḍa anda i d-yettunefken, mačči s tikelt n tikli Start. I Minecraft neɣ Satisfactory, taggayt n Imḍebbren n Tameɣra tettmeslay tiɣriwin nniḍen.
Ad d-yesseqdec i wid ur nelli ara deg tdukli-inek, d talɣa n tdukli-inek. Qbel ad tesɛuḍ belli amseqdac yettxeddem deg umkan.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Yal taɣawsa n uḍar yessefk ad tesɛu isem-is d tfaska n tsertit-is. Synix yessuqel isem n uselkim ɣer Windows- taggayt yettbanen i useqqamu n tfaska d usebter n usebter. D aya i d-yeǧǧan tiɣriwin ɣef tmeslayin ur neɛǧib ara; Mačči d tmacint taswirant neɣ d ugaraw n tɣellist.
TAMURT TAMURT • C:\Synix ?? amḍiq ameqqran n uxeddim n yedlisen Synix. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> ‡ normal installations server. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? root backup normal. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? isefra n useqdec d isallen n usemmiḍ.
Imedyazen n uselmed MSI llan s umata deg %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Llan kra n tmeslayin d tiɣawsiwin i yettwaḥassen Windows ula d nettat i d-iteddun ɣer uselmed Windows-inek.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday Ssexdem Install & Launch mi ara d-tefremt amaru n uselkim. Akken ad d-tettunefkeḍ tikelt tamaynut, ḍfer yiwen n uḍar ur nesɛi azal i wurar akked usebter. Ur tettili ara sin n yimeslayen deg yiwen uselmed.
Open Server Folder yettban amkan n uselkim i d-yefren. Open Backup Folder yettban amkan-is n uḍebsi; Ur ttxemmim ara yiwen n ubrid seg yisem-is.
Imeddukal yezmer ad yidir anda nniḍen Aḥric yezmer ad yesbedd ddunit deg AppData, Documents, yiwen n uselkim nniḍen, neɣ deg usenfaṛ-is. Ẓer amkan-nni n umennuɣ uqbel ad t-id-tesbedduḍ neɣ ad t-tḥewweḍ.
Ad d-yessuqel isem neɣ ad yessuqleḍ isekkilen deg File Explorer ur d-yeɛni ara belli yal abrid yettwasellek ad yettwaselmed. Use Synix supported import/transfer workflow and review paths before the next start. Ula d tiɣriwin tineggura teḥwaǧen tiɣriwin n uḍar ur neqqimen ara.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers tessexdem amseqdac-is n Serveur Dedicé officiel, i ilaq ad yeqqim Synix yettbanen. Asmi i d-yeffɣen tikkelt tamezwarut, nefk Local/Console, nefk Continue to server configuration, nefk iseddin n uselkim d umaḍal, nefk Save & start. Sseqdec amḍebrir n uselkimen i d-yedduklen, ddunit, mods, imḍebren, d tmeslayt-is. Synix yeṭṭef taḍala-a ddaw n useqdec n Instance. Tawsit Local/Console n tazwara ur teḥwaǧ ara izerfan n uselkim; ssebba Windows yes. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer .NET Framework 4.8 neɣ ugar, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 d 2017, ma ulac 6 GB n ubrid RAM, d UDP taɣiwant 27016 yeǧǧa-d ad iɛeddi Windows D tafyirt n tmeslayin, d tin i d-yessersen deg uselkim n imseqdacen n Internet. Aselway ameqqran: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Aɛessas-nni yettḥassed isebtaren n uselkim i yettwassen, yerna yezmer ad d-yessebded tiɣawsiwin i d-yettunefken mi d-yeffeɣ yiwen n usebter ur nettwali ara neɣ mi d-yewwi ugur.
TAMURT TAMURT Use Synix' s Imḍebbren n usekkil d usekkil n usekkil i yimeddukal. Synix tesseqdec timeddukliyin-nni akked uḍar n umeksa akken ad yettwaḥseb tiɣri i d-yettunefken ur d-tettili ara am ugur.
Aḥric n ṭṭaq n wurar, a t-id-yessuɣen deg Task Manager, neɣ ad tt-id-yeqqimen s uselkim nniḍen yezmer ad d-iban ur nettraǧu ara, dɣa ad d-yefken tuɣalin.
TETTAYYYEN-d tikli-nni Qebbel aselkim-nni ɣer Synix, imir-a ttɛawḍeḍ azday n urar. Sseḥbes ugur n usebter, n umennuɣ, n tmeslayt, n usmekti, neɣ n usebter uqbel ad d-tessnulfu. Tamɣawsa ur tezmir ad t-tessewweḍ ameddal ur neṭṭif ara neɣ talɣa ur d-tessaweḍ ara.
Tameɣra n usebter d uselmed ur nelli ara d iɣeblan yemgaraden. Azal n umussu yeṭṭef-d ɣef ccɣel d tegnit-nni, ihi ur tettawiḍ ara yal taswiɛt s yiwen n usebter.
TAMURT Synix yettarra isekkilen i d-yettunefken akk-d tiɣriwin n warraw i d-yeqqnen ɣer uselkim. Tiɣriwin tiɣriwin i yettwaselmen s tefyirt neɣ iserdasen n tsertit zemren ad ɛeddun ugar n tmeslayt-nni yerna ḥwaǧen tiɣriwin n urar.
Aḥric ur d-yeṭṭef ara amḍiq n tiɣriwin i d-yesseknen neɣ nmuqel yiwen n uselkim i d-yedduklen tikelt-is tamezwarut.

2. Ssebded 'Game.ini' akken ad d-tessefk tiwsit n uselkim n uselkim n tmeslayt n uḍebsi.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Sseqdec isekkilen n tudert n Synix akken ad d-txedmeḍ uselkim ameqqran. D aya i d-yeǧǧan aɛessas ad yeẓer amḍiq n ttuɣaḍt seg umennuɣ.
START Select the entry, then select Start once. Synix yettnadi tiɣriwin, iberdan, iɣarman i d-yettunefken, yettwaḥseb isefra n useqdec, yettheggi ifayilen i d-yeffɣen, yerna yessuter uselkim. Rǧu ad d-yeffeɣ wayen i d-yewwi uqbel ad tɛerḍeḍ.
STOP Select STOP and allow the game time to save and close. Synix yesseqdac asekkil n usemmiḍ i yettwaɛǧeb ma yella, syenna ad d-yeqqel tiɣawsi n uḥeddar s temsirin ma yella lḥal. Tameẓla n umennuɣ yezmer ad t-yerr uqbel ur d-yettunefki ara.
RESTART Select Restart to stop the current process group and start a new instance. Ur tebdiḍ ara tikli-nniḍen s ufus mi ara yeḍru waya.
MAY-YETTAWLMAY-D TAMURT Yezmer ad yili yiwen n uselmed nniḍen i yesɛan yakan aserwer-nni, addal yezmer ad yili deg tallit, neɣ urar-nni yezmer ad yessexdumeḍ yiwet n tmeslayt tazelṭant. Ɣṛeḍ awal n tɣawsiwin d izerfan n usenfar.
Ḥebseḍ ad t-teqqleḍ amseqdac deg Task Manager neɣ ad t-tḥebseḍ seg uselmed ur nesɛi ara tagnit i tɣawsiwin imezwura. Ayagi yezmer ad d-iban am usebter ur nettṛaǧu ara, ad d-yeffu ad d-yekkes.
Timura i d-yettwakalen s tmacint taswirant neɣ s yizenfan n useqdec n beṛṛa, teḥwaǧen tiktiwin n tudert-nsen. Aḥric n tmeslayt ur d-yefki ara belli tilelliyin-nni ḥebsen.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory yeḥwaǧ ad d-yettunefkem amezwaru deg umenzu n Server-is deg urar. Synix yezmer ad yesseqdec d ad yeffeḍ uselkim yettwassnen, maca ur d-yettawi ara ad d-yerr uselkim n uselkim neɣ ad d-yexdem tmeslayt-is.
Aḍar-nni ad yekfu 1. Ssebba Satisfactory taggayt, beddel-itt deg Synix. 2. Ḥerǧu ad yekfu uselkim i d-yettunefken. 3. Ldi Server Manager n Satisfactory deg urar, rnu-t neɣ select aselkim. 4. Rnu-t, ssbelɛemt tasertit n uselkim n uselkim, dɣa tselleḍ iman-nwen d aselkim. 5. Ssebba neɣ tkecmeḍ tagnit i tebɣiḍ ad tesqedceḍ.
Synix yettwalin tiɣriwin n usebter/tameẓla i yettwasemmalen, gar-asen tafyirt n usebter d MaxPlayers. Ifaylen i yettwaxedmen llan ddaw n FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer -NewConsole. ma tessukkeḍ taḍrit-a, rnu s Synix. 2. Use the same Windows permission level for Synix d uselkim, ma yella d imeslayen n umseqdac amaynut. 3. Xtiṛ aseqdac-nni, ldi Tiferniwin n Useqdac → Satisfactory Centre n uḥekkem → Sdukel API. 4. Select Connect automatic once and wait.
Synix yettceggeɛ server.GenerateAPIToken, yeɣra iffeɣ-nni amaynut, yettwaḥqel API n tmurt, yerna yeṭṭef taggayt i d-yessufren i uselkim-ik Windows. Taggayt-nni tessefk-as azruf i uselkim, mačči kan ad d-teṭṭef tajmilt.
Isebtaren n uselmed Token yettwaḥeqqeqen yerna yettwaḥrez s tɣellist, dɣa yeffra Overview. Ur teḥwaǧeḍ ara ad ttekkiḍ tawsit n tmeslayt neɣ ad tesseqceḍ tagnit s ufus.
Ma yella ur d-yewwi ara uselmed, Synix yettḥerrez kra n temsalt i d-yettunefken uqbel, yerna ur yettnadi ara tikli-nni tikkelt nniḍen. Ɣeṛ asefru-nni uqbel ad tɛerḍeḍ tikkelt nniḍen.
Yettuneqqel ɣer uselkim i d-yefren deg uselkim-a; ur yeḥwaǧ ara yiwen n uḍal amaynut n uselkim i Synix. Start, Stop, and Restart normal still work without a API token.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Ffer aseɣwen n usebter, teldi-d Tiferniwin n uqeddac. D tiɣawsiwin kan i d-yettunefken s ufus-a d talɣa-ines tatrart i d-yettunefken.
DISSAWILEN D TAMURT • Open Server Folder d Open Backup Folder i d-yeffɣen imukan yettɣaren. • Ad d-yeffre umedyaz n tmeslayin i d-yettunefken ifayilen n tmeslayin i yettwaɛawanen. • Update Server yeṭṭef-d asebtar n uḍar yettwaɛǧeb. • Tḥeqqeḍ tiɣriwin n Game Files neɣ tessewwiḍ tiɣriwin i d-yettunefki umseqdac. • Backup and Restore ḥerzen neɣ uɣalen i tmeslayt i yettwaferren. • Create Batch File yettunefk-d asaru n usebtar mi ara t-id-yekkes amaru. • Ddelte yesseffu yiwen n usebter, yerna yefka-d kan tilelliwin i d-yettunefk akken ad t-nesseffu amaru-s i d-yettban deg tsertit-is.
ISELTAYEN D TAMsalt n usaru Isebtaren n temsalt ttbanen tiɣriwin, iɣarman, d tiktiwin n umeslay. Imḍebbren n tmeslayt, ameslay n Mod & Plugin Manager, imazighen Minecraft, d uḥric n uselkim Satisfactory ad d-iban anda yettunefken.
SYERR A SERVANT YEGZEN Ɛeddi-d tikli deg uḍar-is akken ad d-teẓreḍ isebtaren n uselkim. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Live Process Details" ttbanen isekkilen yettwaḥeqqaren, imezdaɣ n tmeslayt, d imenzayen n uxeddim i d-iqqimen deg usebter-nni. Aḍar n useqdec yezmer ad yesɛu ugar n yiwen n uselmed n useqdec.
Sseqdec asmel n uselmed akken ad tmuqel CPU n umseqdac-nni d amezruy n tesmekti. Tiɣriwin-agi tbanen seg umezruy n uselkim akk n uselkim n useqqamu.
Tameɣra n yineggura neɣ n uḍebsi n yedrimen ur d-teḥbes ara wurar. Sseqdec-d tagnit "Stop" deg usebter ma yella d akken i tebɣiḍ.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Select the Minecraft Edition uqbel ad d-tefren imeddukal neɣ isebtaren n useqqamu. Java d Bedrock d timsirin n useqdec i yeffɣen; Bedrock mačči d amaruz n Java.
Ssebba n uselkim 1. Create a Minecraft entry and select Java or Bedrock. 2. I Java, xtaṛ-d tiɣri n Minecraft, taserdut, d tiɣri n taserdut i yemsefhamen i d-yettunefken imseqdacen. 3. Ẓer ddunit, amkan n wurar n umezgun, taḥeqqiḍt n imseqdac, tasemmirt, tiwwura, d yiberdan n tɣellist i d-yeǧǧan. 4. Salve and Start deg Synix. 5. Qqareḍ ayen akk i d-yettunefken neɣ qbel ad t-tesleḍ. 6. Ḥerǧu ad yekfu ddunit ad t-tḥewweṣ, imir-n ad d-teqqneḍ s usebter n umseqdac i d-yettunefkan. 7. Qqbel ad ternuḍ modification-nni, ssebba ɣef umahil n uxeddim.
JAVA D BEDROCK Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer Java: Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, d Purpur anda llan iẓuran. Sseqdec asebter-nni u ssebba n yiɣilen; Paper d Purpur ssexdamen plugins, ma d Fabric, Forge, d NeoForge ssexdamen modsen-nsen. Synix yettwaḥseb azday n usebter i d-yettwassnen seg umseqdac-is ameqqran.
Bedrock yesseqdac aɣbel n Serveur dédié officiel Bedrock ur yesseqdac ara Java.
SSAYEN TAMsirt Select the loader required by your mods. Select the loader required by your mods. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " 'Minecraft " '
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, d yipakken n plugin-server ur ttwaṭṭfen ara. Asebtar n Mods neɣ Plugins ur d-yettunefki ara azref n uselkim neɣ n useqdec yettwaḥwaǧen. Browse Catalog ur yelli d asekkil n usebter neɣ n usebter n txeṭṭa.
TAMURT Isebtaren i sɛan azday n server.properties d isebtaren i d-yellan ɣef usebter. Java tesɛa daɣen amkan Spectator. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtar i sɛan azday ɣer " Minecraft yettṛaǧu.
Seg Isebtaren n umseqdac, ruḥ Centre n uselkim Minecraft. Isebtar-is n Imḍebbren i d-yettunefkifen ifaylen n umseqdac i yezmer ad yettheddar. Edit File i d-yettunefsus n usefru; Amedyaz amaruz i d-yettunefk amedyaz yeẓran amaruz yellan. Kra seg-sen ad d-ssellek tizmura mi ara yeqqel uselkim. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer server.properties am ugaraw, azday n imseqdac, umaḍal, tazzayt, amkan, d iseddin n uselmed n uselmed ula d tiɣriwin i d-yeffɣen seg Synix. Isem/MOTD i d-yettunefkaren yettwaḥseb ɣef yisem n uḍebsi amkan. Isebtaren ur nelli ara n mod qqimen deg idlisen-nsen.
Synix yeqqra-d tiktiyin-agi akken ad d-yessuqel usebter neɣ ad t-id-yessnulfu, akked mi ara yettwaxdem Refresh mi ara yettwaḥbes. Ma yella yiwen n uḍebsi i d-yeffɣen si beṛṛa ur d-yewwi ara neɣ yeqqel ɣer yiwet n tkebbanit nniḍen, kkes ugur-nni s yisem-is am wakken ur tetteddu ara ad d-tesbeddu umseqdac. Amedyaz yeṭṭef-d ad yekkes amaru yettbeddlen segmi i d-yessufɣen; ruf-itt akken ad d-ternuḍ ayen i d-yeffɣen.
YEBBEN TAMURT n useqdec Qqbel ad tbeddleḍ tifsirin neɣ isekkilen, ḥadret aseɣwen n uselkim akk-a. Select the new runtime in Setup, save the revised entry, then select Apply Runtime in Minecraft Control Center. Synix yettheggi azday n usebter n usebter s tazelda, yettḥerrez server.properties d tdukliwin n umaḍal, yerna yettekker idlisen n uzday n usebter i d-yedduklen. Ur d-yettbeddil ara s yiman-is aserwer. Amzwaru yettwaḥebbes mi ara d-yeqbel umezruy n usebter d amaru i d-yettwassnen.
Taɣawsa n udlis ur d-tekkes ara tizmeddinin n ddunit i d-yettwaxedmen mi yebda uselkim. Ur ttxemmim ara ma yella yiwen n umaḍal i d-yeffɣen s Minecraft amaynut neɣ modiyen yemgaraden yezmer ad d-yettunefken s talwit tameqqrant; Ad d-nernu aseqqamu amaynut.
Ḥebseḍ uqbel ad tbeddleḍ idlisen i yessefk ad d-ternuḍ. Ur ilaq ara ad d-tbedduḍ ddunit i yellan s yiwen n usebter amaynut akken ad d-tessewweḍ.
Ma ur zmiren ara imurar ad d-ddunt Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " Akken ad d-teffɣeḍ zik, ẓer taggayt n urar ɣef tuccḍa, tallit n umennuɣ, tasmekta neɣ tiɣriwin n txeṣṣart.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Ffkeḍ Tazrawt n Utaru n Satisfactory mi ara d-teqqneḍ tazzayt n API. Select tab for the operation you need.
Aḥric amecṭuḥ Select Refresh akken ad teɣriḍ isem n tmeslayt, ad d-teqqneḍ ad d-telleḥḥu umedya/tameɣra, tallit n wurar, taswiɛt n useqdec, lweqt n urar, akked unagraw n ttekni.
Ad d-yesseqdec umedyaz n tmeslayt s ttawil ma yella temsalt teṣfa; tabla n umezruy tettwaḥseb ɣef usuter. API-a i d-yettunefkan tiɣriwin, mačči d isem n imeɣnasen. Aɣil yeṭṭfen neɣ aserwer yettraǧu ad d-yeqqim mačči d amennuɣ yeṭṭfen.
SETTINGS SERVER Select Refresh, edit supported values, then Apply changes. Rnu-d ad d-tesɛuḍ tiɣriwin i d-yettwaṭṭfen mi ara d-teffɣeḍ. Kra n tiktiwin teḥwaǧen ad d-ternuḍ; ma yella tettbeddil, ur d-yettbeddil ara tikli s automatik.
Asebtar n yiɣallen d tiɣawsiwin i yettwassen qqimen deg tutlayt n tkarra.
Igraren yettwasellekken • Iḥrez tura: Ɛreḍ isem neɣ tesqedceḍ isem n Synix i d-yeffɣen. Asebtar ad yettwasqedcen s yisem yezmer ad d-yessuqleḍ asellek yellan. • Taɣawsa yettwaferren: Isebtaren i sɛan azday. Synix yettekker taggara n umezgun d amezwaru mi yella tesɛedda yiwet n tmeslayt; Aḥric yezmer ad yekkes imseqdacen. • Aḍeggu n usefru: Yennayer afaylu i d-yefren yerna yezmer ad yerr asebter s yiwen n yisem. Ur tt-yettaɣ ara s ttawil. • Yettwaɣalen asmel: Yeḥrez yiwet n tikli ɣer ubrid amkan-nni i d-tefrun.
Ɣur-k ad d-ternuḍ tiɣriwin n lɛali qbel ad tesbedduḍ neɣ ad tkecmeḍ ddunit meqqren. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer 512 MB taggara n tɣellist. API yezmer ad yili ur yessaweḍ ara s tallit mi ara d-yettunefk tmeɣra.
TAMURT TAMURT Ssiwel yiwen n uselmed n wurar i yettwaḥesben deg yiwet n tikelt, ɣṛeḍ aseɣwen. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Scripts, token/password commands", d timeddukal n usebter ur nelli ara.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer Synix Taɣawsa n uselmed teqqim deg ṭṭaq-a wala ad t-id-ternu deg uḍar neɣ deg yizerfan n uḍris Synix; Urar-nni yezmer ad d-yettaru adlis-is.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705
data.value: Adlis n uselmed ɣef yiẓuran n plugin i Java-Isebtaren n uselkim n uselkim. Tiɣriwin n tura d tiɣriwin i d-yedduklen tesqedcen APIs yemgaraden; Ẓer asekkil d amaru n tmeslayt i d-yessersen uqbel ad tesqedceḍ yiwen n usebter.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
izemren ad d-yessuteren isefka n wurar s waṭas n yimurar:
Synix tesseggza-d amussu n uselkim ameqqran, maca ur yezmir ad d-yekkes, ad yekkes, neɣ ad yernu ifayilen i d-yefkan tilelli seg wurar n umezgun. Ma yeqqar uselkim-nni d ayen ixuṣṣen deg uḍar multiplayer neɣ d acu i d-yeffɣen mi ara d-yettunefken neɣ ad ibeddel tiɣriwin, tesseqceḍ Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer s Steam s useqdec n umeslay i t-yewwin. Kkes-d ayen yellan deg mpsrc multiplayer seg tkeṛṛust n urar-nni ɣer useqdec-a n uselkim i d-yettunefkan, dɣa ẓer ma mapcycle.txt d maplist.txt tesɛan tiɣriwin i tebɣiḍ ad tezzum.
Aḍar-a ilaq ad t-id-yerr umseqdac i d-yettunefken aserwer. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "0 Deathmatch", "1 Team Deathmatch", "2 Crusade", "3 Capture the Flag" d "4 Colosseum".

data.name: Content.2B58E9F9AC7FE77A9E6C
data.value: Yettwaḥwaǧ yiwen n uḍebsi n Metamod:Source d SourceMod i usentel-agi n useqdec. Plugins .smx i d-yettuneqqen qqaren deg tf/addons/sourcemod/plugins; Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Aql- d asefru n Connect akken iwata uqbel ad tɛerḍeḍ. Taɣawsa i d-tettban deg tmeslayt n urar ur d-teḥeqqeǧ ara belli ttwaṭṭfen, ttwalin, yerna ttwafferent akk.
QQEL TAMURT TAMURT • Tiddukla ur d-tettawi ara: Ɛqel -NewConsole, amseqdac i d-yefren, d izerfan n tezmert n Windows. • Taɣawsa ur d-tessaweḍ ara deg uḍebsi: Ffemt-tt s yiman-nwen. Synix ur tt-yettaru ara. • Taɣawsa tetteddu, maca ur d-tettwaṭṭef ara yiwet n tmeslayt: Ad teffɣeḍ awal, ad teẓreḍ isekkilen n urar i yettwaxedmen, yerna ad teǧǧeḍ ad d-tuweḍ usebter amaynut. • Isekkilen yettḥebsen: Ssefk-d isekkilen i d-yettunefken/iḥesben, dɣa ad yeǧǧ asekkil ad d-yerr. • API port yeqqen ɣer usebter nniḍen: Ssewweḍ tawwurt n urar i d-yettwaferren. Ur t-id-tceggiḍ ara adlis-is i win ur nesli ara. • Taɣawsa i d-yekkes neɣ taḥsebt i d-yeffɣen ur yezmir ad tt-id-yekkes: Sqedceḍ asnulfu n tmeɣra, dɣa sbeddeḍ-t. • API ur d-yettili ara: Ḥerǧen ad d-yeldi neɣ ad d-tesseḥḍu tcelḥit, dɣa ẓer taggayt n wurar.
Tiririt tamaynut tezmer ad tesɛu yiwet n tgelda am tiririt tamezwarut. Capture tessexdem-d output i d-yettunefken deffir taggayt, mačči d yiwen n uḍris aqdim deg usefru.
QQELTA neɣ Tekkemt Aḍris Satisfactory yettḍebber tiɣriwin n uselkim deg tmeslayt-is d usefru-ines. Ḥadret-asent d tidett, ḥebset isekkilen n tmeslayin seg usekran d yisallen.
Synix yettwaḥqel ma d amkan-nni n taggara n umkan i d-yettwaferren, yerna yeṭṭef asertifikat-is. Ur tt-id-yeǧǧ ara ad d-tḥewweṣ tiɣriwin n tsertifikat akken ad d-tessewwiḍ tneṣfa.
Efk-d tiɣriwin n tmeslayt i yettwasellek Synixd taqqunt yettwaṭṭfen; ur d-yekkes ara taggayt deg uselkim.
I wakken ad d-yekkes isekkilen n useqdec yellan, server.InvalidateAPITokens deg SatisfactoryAdlis n uselkim neɣ aselkim n uselkim. D aya daɣen i d-yettrawen tiɣmiwin nniḍen s useqdec n tikliyin-nni.
I useqqamu nniḍen n Windows neɣ uḍebsi i d-yettwaǧǧan, rnu-t ma yella ur yezmir ara ad yettwaxdem uḍebsi yettwaḥesben.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Ɣeṛ azday n umseqdac i d-yettwaferren d usaru n urar. Ttxil-k ad d-tafeḍ taṣebḥit tamezwarut, mačči kan s usefru-nni aneggaru.
TAMURT I D-Yettbeddlen neɣ I D-Yettbeddlen Zik 1. Ẓer amḍebber n tseddurt i d-yettwassen, amḍebber, usebter n wurar, d amḍebber. 2. Ẓer ifaylen i d-yeḥwaǧen, azref n RAM/disk, d tiwwura yettwakalen. 3. Sqedceḍ ayen akk i d-yefkan, ad tesmelḍeḍ ɣer usebter, ad ternuḍ tikli, neɣ ad ternuḍ taggayt deg urar. 4. I yimuddiyen, qsim-d urar-nni, taserdast, tiɣawsiwin, d wayen i d-yeḥwaǧ umsuɣel. 5. Ḥebseḍ ɣer Synix uqbel ad tbeddleḍ idlisen, dɣa ttɛerḍeḍ tikelt.
Yezmer ad yeqqim yiwen n uḍebsi yeddren mi d-yeɣli umseqdac n tidet. Asebtar igerzen tezmer daɣen ad yettraju ad d-yettunefkar deg umaḍal neɣ ad yesɛu yiwet n temsalt ur telli/API. Ẓer tiɣriwin-nni ɣef yiman-is.
Yettwaṭṭef-d lweqt ad yekfu neɣ ad yeqqel Timura ttwaḥwaǧen akud i wakken ad tesɛuḍ d ad tqecmeḍ timsal n umxeddim. Rǧu ɣer usefru n Synix, ɣṛeḍ-d awal-is. Tameɣra-nni i d-yettunefk ad t-yeɣli, yezmer ad yeɣli deg-s lḥal ur nettwassen ara.
Ur ilaq ara ad t-ternuḍ timsirin s tikelt, ad tebduḍ tikli nniḍen, neɣ ad tesqedceḍ amehder nniḍen ɣef yiwet n tsertit.
Yella yiwet n tesɣunt neɣ taḥawsa i d-yeǧǧan Ẓer taswiɛtin n usenfar d tallit-is. Llan kra n tiktiwin i d-yesseklen imi ur ten-yeṭṭef ara wurar neɣ ulac aɣilif n uselkim yettwaḥdem. N/A data player ur tettili ara s yiman-is d amennuɣ n uselkim.
Ma yeqqim ugur-nni, rray ayen i d-yexdem, amḍal-nni akk-d yiwen n uḍris amecṭuḥ i d-yettwaḥseb uqbel ad tbeddeḍ kra nniḍen ur nezmir ara.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
ssebded neɣ ssqedceḍ aḍebsi n uselkim 1. Xeddem-d asebtar n umseqdac akk d lbaṭel, ḥebset umseqdac. Use Synix with normal Windows permissions. 2. Ssebba d useqdec n uḍebsi n Minecraft i d-yettunefkan, d amaruz, d amaruz amezwaru. 3. Deg Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, xtiṛ Import Server Pack. Ffer-d Modrinth .mrpack neɣ ZIP n uqeddac akkin yesɛan imuddiren n tidett d isefka n usnerni. 4. Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg taggayt: Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Modrinth" ur tt-id-yettunefken ara. 5. Muqel ssebba n usefru, tesmekti n metadata, ayen i d-yeǧǧan, d yal adlis i ilaq ad t-yeddun, ad ttwaṭṭfen neɣ ad ttweḥcmen. Ẓer-d kan ma yella d asmi i d-yefkan d timgarad. 6. Ddem s ufus mi d-teqqimeḍ, ɣṛeḍ taselkimt-nni, dɣa ttɛerḍeḍ tdukli n umseqdac i d-yeffɣen.
Amseqdec ur yexdem ara iskripten n usebtu i d-yettunefkan deg uḍar, ur yettbeddil ara tiɣremin, neɣ ur yettaru ara azref server.properties. Download full server pack n umaru ma yella CurseForge Taɣawsa n uselkim tesɛa kan ameslay n usebtar. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " Synix ur tɛezzi ara tiḥricin n umseqdac.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Modrinth" ttwaḥesben s hash. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "JAR" Isebtaren n umata ur nessin d isebtaren imeqqranen n uḍrisen i d-yeḥwaǧen leqder. Aḍris n tmeslayt yečča neɣ ulac n wuguren i yettwassen ur d-yeɛni ara ma yella amedya yettbanen neɣ yettemmal. Ur tt-id-yettunefkarent ara tiɣawsiwin i d-yeffɣen.
Ad d-yeqqel ad d-yekkes JAR-s i d-yettwaselmen zik, ma d akken ur d-yeddin ara, maca kan mi ara d-yeqqlen timedyazt-nni i d-yettwaṭṭfen. JARs ur yettwaselkimen d idlisen n umaḍal ur tt-yeffɣen ara. Imedyazen n umennuɣ i d-yefkan s uḍebsi amaynut zemren ad beddlen imedyazen iqburen; Ad ten-id-yessken uqbel ad d-tessekleḍ. Ḥadret isem n udem n uselkim-ZIP am akken i d-yettwassnen am akken i d-yettwassen am akken.
TAMURT n umaḍal Seqdec Amaḍal akken ad d-tefkeḍ umuɣ n umaḍal yettwasnen. "Import World ZIP" yettak-d yiwen n umaḍal n tsuqilt i yedduklen ɣer usebter amaynut; Ur ttarra ara ɣef umaḍal yellan yakan neɣ ur tettbeddil ger Java d Bedrock. Ffer-d amaḍal yettwasbedden d Activate World akken ad tbeddleḍ isem n uswir d usbeddel n umaḍal n Synix. Asnulfu-nniḍen ad yerr amaḍal yettwafernen. Abeddel n yizerfan yettwaḥsab deg usnulfu n umaḍal amaynut, mačči deg wakal yellan yakan.
TAMURT Asebtaren i d-yettunefken tizmeddin n usefru i d-yexdem useqdec-a. Undo yettas-d idlisen i d-yettwaṭṭfen seg uqbel neɣ itekkid idlisen i d-yedduklen s usebter-nni. Rnu-d seg umaḍal yettunefken uqbel ad t-tekkseḍ. Ma d ifaylen i d-yettwaxedmen, Synix yexxeṛ ad ten-yessuqel; ttḥerrez tiɣriwin-nni d useqdec n uḍebsi amḍiq i yeɛnan ma yella lḥal.
Aḥersi n tuɣalin i d-iteddun, yebda alamma yekfa tuɣalin yerna taɣilt yettwasellek tettemsefham d idlisen i d-yeqqlen. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tameẓla" Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "
Mi d-yessufeɣ uselmed n useɣru, ttwaḥesben isefra iqdimen n tiktiwin n umezgun amzun d aseɣru-nni. Qqimen ad tt-id-walin akken ad tt-id-sseknen, maca ur zmiren ara ad tt-id-rren s wudem n idlisen i d-yedduklen. Aḍeggu n usefru neɣ usebter n umezruy mi ara d-yeqqleb, ad d-yekcem isefra n usefru i d-yettunefken.
DISNASTICS D TAMURT Taɣawsiwin n uḍrisen n usebter n usebter d usebter n usebter i wuguren n Java i yeɛnan, tameddurt, txeṣṣart, umaḍal, d wuguren n tallit. Ulac aɣilif i d-yettban ur d asebter ara belli amseqdac yeḥla. Assexdamen yettɣelleb amḍan n uselmed; CPU and RAM tiɣriwin ur d-yeṭṭfen ara amḍiq i uselkim n tmeskin n uḍar.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Synix" Select the desired days, time, player-waiting behavior, backup, and update options, then review and save. Amkan n uxeddim ur d-yettunefki ara amedyaz wis sin neɣ ad ibeddel amedyaz-ik s ttawil.

data.value:
Select the Minecraft Serveur, puis ouvrir Serveur Options → Minecraft Control Center. Isebtaren n Console d Players ttbeddilen tiɣawsiwin n uselmed akked uḍar. Isebtar-nniḍen ttbanen tiɣriwin, ddunit, add-ons, tiɣriwin n umseqdac i d-yettunefkan akk, ad d-yeqqel uɣawas, ad d-yessufeɣ, ad d-yesseqdec.
IWENNEN n uselmed Isebtaren i d-yettunefken zemren ad ssqedcen asebter yettunefken Synix, amkan n uselkim n umezgun localhost yettunefken, neɣ RCON. Adlis i d-yeffɣen yeṭṭef-it ɣef usebter d uselmed n uselkim.
Tazewwurt taɣelnawt yeffren mazal tezmer ad ternu yiwet n tmeslayt n uselmed amkan. Ma yella tneǧǧa-d tilelli, ẓer ma yetteddu uselkim-nni yerna ma d tiddukla n tsertit-is i tt-yettunefk.
TAMURT ICEHDEN Ma yella yettunefken, Synix i d-yettunefkan isallen, isekkilen n imeɣnasen, usemmiḍ, tibeddilen n umseqdac d imeɣnasen, tilelliwin n lweqt/tnefsit, akked usefru.
Ffer-d amyurar-nni i d-tettwaliḍ u ɣeṛ tikli-nni uqbel ad tt-tesbeṛneḍ. Ma yefka-d uḍris n umseqdac, ad d-yefk izerfan imeqranen i wurar. Ur t-tettak ara kan akken ad tefruḍ ugur n useqqamu.
Iḍebsiyen n lbaṭel Sseqdec asebter i d-yettṛaǧun deg usebter-nni. Isebtaren i sɛan azday am list d save-all d tiɣriwin n wurar, ur ttwasuqilen ara s useqqamu n Synix. Ẓer ilugan n tmeslayt n wurar uqbel ad d-terremt tmeslayt i d-ibeddlen tiɣremin neɣ izerfan.
ISMAWEN D YISMAW Taɣawsa tezmer ad d-ternu azal n yimeddukal mebla tarrayt yettwassnen s yisem. Tabla n yisem yečča ur d-tefki ara s yiman-is belli ulac win i d-yeddukklen.
Sseqdec taggayt-nni n "Stop" neɣ "Restart" i ubeddel n umennuɣ n tudert akken ad yeẓer umɛellem belli ttuɣaḍt-nni d tamsalt.
Ḥadret RCON neɣ iswiyen n uselmed i d-yettunefken deg umaḍal, ma yella ur tesɛiḍ ara amennuɣ n uselmed seg useqdec. Taɣawsa n wurar ur teḥwaǧ ara ad d-teffɣeḍ tiɣriwin-nni neɣ tiɣriwin n taggara.

SYNIX CONTROL PANEL ?? LICENSE PROPERTARY LIMITED SOURCE-available
Tasɣunt n tlellizt 1.4 ?? November 11, 2026
D asebter n tlelli, mačči d anagraw n uḍebsi Synix. Copyright © 2026 Jason Turner. D iqeddcen akk i d-yettunefken. Amrik Taggayt n uselmed n umsuɣil:
Tazeɣt-a tettwasemmar ɣef uselkim n Synix Control Panel, deg-s uḍris-is n uselkim, isekkilen n useqdac, udlisen n umseqdac, udlisen, tẓuriwin, isekkilen, d tɣawsiwin nniḍen i d-yettunefken (tameẓla: ?? Software ??).
Isebtaren 13 d 14 ttmeslayen daɣen ɣef timsirin n tɣellist n websayt uselmed n Synix, ameṭṭu n lxedma, d amseqdac n useqdec. Tessawalen axeddim-nni n tura; ur beddlent ara tafaska n tlelli n wemdan, mačči n tsertit i yellan ddaw-a.
1. Taggayt
Aselkim-nni yettunefken, ur yettunefk ara.
Jason Turner yeṭṭef-d akk lḥeqq, tagnit, d lxilaf deg u deg uselkim, gar-asent akk yidrimen n uselmed akked yidrimen-nniḍen n tmusni. Kra n yiɣallen n wemkan ur d-teddun fell-akent s tezmert-a.
2. Asebtar n tlelli yettunefken
S ugur i tt-id-yefkan akk isertiwen n tlelli-yagi, tettunefk-ak-d tlelli yettwaḥricen, ur neqqel ara, ur d-yettwarrem ara, ur d-yettwarrem ara, yerna ad d-ttuɣaleḍ:
- Tekkes-d u tessexdem Aselkim-nni i yiswiwen-ik, mačči n tsertit. Ẓer d teɣri n uḍris-nni. Xeddem-d tikliwin n tefsut i useqdec-nwen. - Tbeddleḍ amḍan n uselkim i useqdec-ik, ur d-yettunefki ara. - Ad d-ternuḍ, ad tɛeddiḍ timedyawin-ik s waṭas n yiɣallen i tesɛam neɣ i teṭṭfeḍ.
Yal lḥeqq ur yettunefk ara s tezmert-agi s wudem amecṭuḥ, yeṭṭef-it umɛellem n yidles.
3. Timedyawin n wemdan
Tzemreḍ ad tesbeddeḍ Taselkimt akken ad teḥbul tiɣriwin-inek n yiman.
Isebtaren-nni n yiman ilaq ad qqimen d tidett alamma Jason Turner yefka-ak-d awal s tira akken ad ten-id-tessufuḍ.
Ur tezmireḍ ara ad d-tessuffeḍ, ad d-tefkeḍ, ad d-teqqareḍ, ad d-tessuqleḍ, ad d-tessuqleḍ neɣ ad d-tessufkeḍ amaru ameddal neɣ ameddal ameddal ameddal i d-yettunefken akken ad d-tessufkeḍ ɣer umdan s wudem n Synix.
4. Taɣawsiwin
Ur tezmireḍ ara, ma ur d-yefki ara awal s tira seg Jason Turner:
4.1 Use Commercial
- Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usebter: - Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut - Tesseqdec aselkim-nni neɣ uḍris-is n usufru d amkan n umezgun yettwaṭṭafen neɣ n tsertit. - Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer Internet"
4.2 Asebtar d usemmiḍ
- Yessekcem, yettwalin, neɣ yeṭṭef Software-nni deg usebtar amaynut, deg unagraw, deg tseddawit n usebtar, deg tmeslayt n usebtar, deg tseddawit n usebtar, neɣ deg tḥanut n uḍebsi. - Aḍebber n uḍebsi n uḍebsi n uselmed neɣ n tdukliwin i d-yettwaɣalen, ma yella yettwasuɣal neɣ ur yettwasuɣal ara. - Ad d-yili neɣ ad d-yessufeɣ imsisyen ur nelli ara, ixef-nni yettwaṭṭafen, tifeṛḍin, neɣ isekkilen n usebtar. - Isebtaren i d-yeffɣen seg yiwet n tferka neɣ ad d-yessuqel yiwen n uḍris n uselkim. - Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usefru:
4.3 Asekles d usekkil
- Tekkes, teffer, neɣ tbeddel isem n Synix, isallen n uselmed, isallen n umyaru, isallen n tlelli, isallen n tlelli, isalan, neɣ taɣunt. - Isem-is d amaynut neɣ isem-is d amaynut n uselmed akken ad yeffeɣ ɣer medden neɣ ad yettwaḍebber. - Tenna-d d kečč i d-yefkan aselkim amezwaru. - Sseqdac isem n Synix neɣ usemmar s wamek ara d-yefken s lekdeb, aselmed, tdukli, neɣ amkan ameqqran.
4.4 Asenfar n usegmi d uḥraz n tɣellist
Akken i t-yeǧǧan uḍris yettɛeddun, ur tezmirem ara ad tkettbem, ad tt-terẓemt, ad tt-terẓemt, neɣ ad ttnadiḍ amek nniḍen akken ad teffɣemt tizeqqaṛin n tlelliwin, tagnit, tifeṛṛiyin n tɣellist, tiḥezzin n usebter, neɣ ad d-tesseqceḍ tabrant i d-yellan deg yiwen n usebter n usebter n ccɣel.
Taɣriḍt-a ur tesɛi ara taḥeqqiḍt i d-yettunefk-ak-d lḥeqq ur t-yeffɣen ara s wudem-is.
5. GitHub Isebtaren i sɛan azday
Ad d-yessiweḍ yiwen n uselmed n Synix ɣef GitHub. GitHub's n tmeslayt ad d-yeǧǧen imseqdacen ad ẓren d ad ttwalin yiwen n usefru ameɣnas GitHub's built-in functionality.
Azzur GitHub ur k-yeǧǧi ara ad:
- Ssebba-d asebter n Synix ur nelli ara. - Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut Rebrand Synix. - Sseqdec aseɣfa n usebtar amgaraden neɣ asmel. - Ssebba-d tafyirt-nni d aselkim-ik. - Ad d-yessuqleḍ Taselkimt anda i d-yettunefkan GitHub.
GitHub Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg taggayt: Synix amaruz. Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut ur d-yettunefk ara d aseqdec ilaq ad qqimen d aylawen n wemdan.
S usekcem n uḍebsi n uẓeṭṭa, isekkilen, leqdic n tẓuri, neɣ ayen nniḍen i d-yettunefken Synix tessawaḍeḍ belli tesɛiḍ azref ad t-tessekcem yerna ad as-tefkeḍ i Jason Turner yiwet n telɣa n useqdec ur nettwaḥbas, ur nettwaṭṭef ara, ur nettwabeddal ara, ur nesɛi taxatemt akken ad t-tesseqdaceḍ, ad t-tɛawdeḍ, ad t-tbeddleḍ, ad t-tessufɣeḍ, ad t-tessersḍ, ad t-tessebḍeḍ, ad t-tessebḍeḍ d akken ad ternuḍ taggayt-nni ɣer SynixD acu-t ?
6. Synix Isem d taggayt
Isem n Synix, taggayt-is, taẓuri-ines, d tmazight i tt-yeddukklen qqimen d tawant n Jason Turner.
Ulac taggayt n tmazight neɣ talɣa n tmazight i d-yefkan s uselkim-a, ala akken ad d-yettban isem n Synix d tmazight ur yettwaxeddmen ara mi ara tesqedceḍ Software-nni.
Lxeddim ur yettunefk ara n tmeslayt n Synix yezmer ad yerẓen tiɣriwin n umsuɣil, isefra n tmazight, uguren ur nelli ara, neɣ cceṛ n cceṛ nniḍen.
7. Asekkil
Iḥeṣṣa-inek s tezmert-agi n tlelli-yagi, ttwaḥebsen s yiman-nsen ma tceṭṭfeḍ kra n temsalt n tlelli-yagi.
Mi teḥbes, ilaq ad:
Ḥebseḍ ad tesqedceḍ neɣ ad tbeddeḍ Software-nni. Ḥebseḍ ad d-tessuqleḍ neɣ ad d-teffreḍ kra n tikli ur neţwaxdem ara. - Tekkes-d tikkunin ur nelli ara, isefra, tmucuha, neɣ tmeslayin ur nelli ara s tezmert-inek. - Sseffɣet tikliwin n wemdan ma yella yettwaḥwaǧ-it lḥal.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday, tiḥebsiwin, isekkilen, isekkilen n tlelli d usizegzaw ur d-yeffɣen ara.
8. Aḥeddim
Amseqdac n yizerfan yezmer ad yeqdec ayen akk i d-yeffɣen deg uḍif yettunefken ɣef usekkil ur yettunefk ara tezmert, usebter, usekles aɣelnaw, ugennun, asmel amaynut neɣ tiɣriwin nniḍen.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut
Ulac acu i d-yettunefk deg tlelli-ya ad d-yefken kra n uselmed neɣ talɣit i d-yettunefkan deg yal tazmert.
9. Taɣawsa n lxedma d temsalt n temsalt
LSAFTWARE yettunefk akken i yella d akken i d-yettunefken, ur yesɛi ara tagriḍt n kra n ṣṣenf, ur d-yefki ara deg wawal neɣ ur d-yefki ara, yezga deg-s tagriḍt n tmeslayit, n uḍebsi i yiwen n uswir, n usemmiḍ, d win ur d-yeddun ara.
Akken i t-yeǧǧa uṣaḍuf, Jason Turner ur yezmir ara ad yettwaḥseb ɣef kra n tɣawsiwin timseqqrant, tidduklant, tidduklant, timsalin, n wayen d-iteddun, neɣ ɣef kra n tɣawsiwin n yedran, n lfayda, n uselmed, n udlisen n umserwer, n ddunit n wurar, n tdukli, neɣ n tsertit i d-yettunefkan seg uselkim neɣ s useqdec-is.
D kunwi i d-yettunefken ad tesɛuḍ tiɣriwin n usebter akked ad tesɛuḍ belli aselkim-nni yelha i tmeslayt-inek d uḍar n usebter n wurar.
10. Isebtaren i sɛan azday
Aselmed n terbaɛt, tbibura, idlisen n usemmiḍ n wurar, SteamCMD Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren tilufa"
Tazrawt-a ttwaxdem kan i yiberdan n Synix i yesɛan Jason Turner.
11. Aseɣwen n tira
Tiɣriwin i d-yettunefkan deg tlelli-a, ttɛeddun kan ma yella Jason Turner i ten-yefka s tira.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer Synix GitHub amaruz neɣ yiwen uselway nniḍen Synix amkan n tmeslayt.
12. Isebtaren i sɛan azday
Ad d-tawiḍ Synix kan s yisem-agi:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Iɣmisen i d-yefkan s wudmawen nniḍen ur ttwaḥeqqren ara Jason Turner, zemren ad uɣalen d ur nesɛin ara tagnit, ad uɣalen d imuḍan, ad uɣalen d imecṭuḥen neɣ ad qqimen d software ur yettwaḥseb ara. Lḥeqq-nsen d lbaṭel-nsen ur tt-yeɛǧeb ara Jason Turner.
Aḥric n Synix, asekkil ɣer GitHub, neɣ aḥric n usebtar ur d-yeǧǧi ara tagnit neɣ ad d-yessebded tazmert, tdukli, taɛdemt, neɣ amkan n ccɣel. Synix mazal d taḥala n Jason Turner.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tameẓla" Asebter i d-yettunefkan s yiwen n usebter agemmal ur d-yefk ara tazmert-a.
Tazrawt 4.2 ur tessexdem ara tiɣawsiwin timellalin ɣer isufaren-a n tsertit i d-yettunefken zSynix d Jason Turner. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tameẓla"
WinGet packet ubidzz.Synix d amkan n useddis yettwassen mi ara d-yessufeɣ aseddis ur yettwaxdem ara srid seg isekkilen n GitHub. Ayagi ur d-yeǧǧi ara ad yeṭṭef yiwen n wemḍebbren neɣ ad yernu.
13. Taggayt n umezgun deg tudert d tiɣri
Synix tesɛa yiwen n uḍebber n lxedma deg tudert i d-yettxemmimen ad d-yernu azgen n tmeslayin Synix i yetteddun ɣef https://synix.info. Tzemreḍ ad tt-id-tesseqqleḍ deg yal taswiɛt deg Isebtaren > Taɣriḍit & Tallamt > Aḍebber n uselmed n uḥeddar ur t-teḥbes ara tifeṛṛiwin nniḍen n Synix. Aḥader yettwaḥader i d-yettwasellek uqbel.
Mi ara t-id-yeǧǧ, Synix yettceggɛa HTTPS taggayt n umyag i https://synix.info/api/presence deg tazwara d azal n yal 10 ddqayeq mi ara d-yexdem uselmed, ula deg uḍris. Aseɣwen yesɛa ungal n tmeslayt tazejdit d usemmiḍ n useqdac Synix, ur nesɛi ara taɣult n yisallen. Amaru n tmeslayt yettwaḥrez kan deg tmekti, yettwaṭṭef amḍiq-is mi yebda tmeslayt tamaynut; mačči d asekkil n useqdec i yeṭṭfen.
Ur d-yettunefki ara isem-ik, tamsalt n yizenzuṛ, imeslayen-ik, isallen n uselkim neɣ n umedyaz, izerfan n usemmiḍ, idlisen, neɣ isekkilen n tkeṛṛust.
Ɣef yal tmeslayt, tiɣriwin n web site-nni ttḥazun kan yiwen n uḍris n tmeslayt d lweqt n uselmed-is i d-yessaweḍ. Asebtar aɣelnaw yettban-d kan ad d-yettunefk azal n yimedduklen i yettnadien, d asmekti mačči d adbal n yimdanen i d-yekkan. Aɣil yeḥbes ad d-yeḥseb mi ara d-yeffɣen ddqayeq 15. Isebtaren i d-yedduklen 30 isefra n lxedma Synix ur d-yessekcem ara isekkilen-agi n usekkil s yiɣallen n umenzu n uḍebsi neɣ isekkilen n useqdec n uselkim.
Tameẓla n tmeslayt-nni tettḥebbes tiɣriwin i d-yettunefken deg-s, yerna tettarra-d yiwet n talɣit akken ad d-tekkes temsalt-a. Tameɣra n Synix tettnadi daɣen ad t-tekkes; ma ur yezmir ara ad d-yaweḍ usekkil ɣer websayt, tagnit teḥbes iman-is mi d-teffeɣ lweqt n lxedma.
Am akken i d-yeḍran akk tiɣriwin n Internet, iserdasen n usebter n web site-nni ttwaṭṭfen isallen n tmeslayt am tin n IP i d-yettunefkan d lweqt n tsuter, yerna zemren ad ten-ḥerzen neɣ ad ten-ḥebsen s yizerfan-nsen n tsertit. Isebtar-agi ur yettwaḥrez ara deg usebter n usekkil n tɣawsiwin n Synix neɣ ur d-yettban ara deg usekkil aɣelnaw.
14. Taɣawsa n tɣellist d tɣellist
14.1 Ad d-yettunefk ad d-yettunefk yiwen n uselmed
Tamaneɣt n uḍebsi deg https://manager.synix.info d tiɣriwin i d-yettunefken armi ad tkettbeḍ aselkim yerna ad tesɛuḍ asekwal i d-yettunefken deg uselmed Synix deg uselkim-nni. Tzemreḍ ad tesqedceḍ Synix s akal mebla asmel n uselkim. Taɣawsa n tɣawsiwin i d-yettwaḥesben yerna tezmer ad tt-tessekkes s yiman-is.
Synix ur tezzenz ara, ur tessaklay ara, ur tessexdam ara neɣ ur d-tessekles ara isallen n ukawnit-ik, isallen n uselkim yettwaqqen, isallen n tigawt taɣerfant, neɣ isallen n uqeddac i yimeskanen neɣ imsebraken n yisallen. Synix ur tesseqdec ara isallen-a i usihel n unadi neɣ ad d-yesnulfu isefka n unadi seg-sen. Isallen ttwasqedcen akken ad d-fken isekkilen i d-tefrareḍ, ad d-sbeggnen amek ara tkecmeḍ, ad tessexdem aseqdec, yerna ad ten-tḥudd ɣef useqdec ur nṣeḥḥa.
Ad d-yesseqdec seg ubrid ur yelli ara d axeddim n umezgun. Yeḥwaǧ-as isefra amecṭuḥen n uḍebsi, n tdukli, n uselmed d n tɣellist i d-yettmeslayen ddaw-a. Isebtaren-agi ur ttwasselment ara deg usekkil n tɣawsiwin tiɣriwin neɣ ur ttwassen ara i yineggura nniḍen n umedyaz s uselkim.
14.2 D acu i yeqqimen deg uselkim-ik
Synix ur d-yettarra ara s yiman-is imḍanen n wurar, isefka n uqeddac n wurar, ayen yellan deg ufaylu n usbeddel, ayen yellan deg usebter n useggem, ayen i d-yeffɣen seg ukunsil neɣ awal uffir n uqeddac n wurar. Aseɣẓan n tuffɣa d uḥezzeb s umalu ɣef uselkim-nni yettwaqqen; Iḍebsiyen n tuqqna ad qqimen deg imukan i d-yettwasbedd din. Ma tferneḍ ad d-tefkeḍ yiwen n uselkim n urar deg usmel, aḍris-is ad yettwaḥseb yerna ad iɛeddi ɣer uselkim-nni yettwaqqnen, ladɣa ma yella kra n wazalen isehlen i d-tefkiḍ deg uḍris-nni. Amɛellem-a mačči d aserked n tuqqna deg usigna yerna ur d-yettak ara asalu (desktop) yebɛin ur nesɛi azref, Windows aselkem s usileɣ, neɣ unadi n isefka.
Synix yettḥerrez isebbaḍen n umkan-is, adlis n uselkim, amezruy, tiɣriwin, d talɣa n useqqamu deg uselkim-ik. Taɣlit n uselkim ameddukel i d-yettwaṭṭfen ad yeqqim deg unagraw Windows. Synix yeqbel ad yeṭṭef amḍiq n usemmam yettunefken s TPM mi ara yili d-yeffeɣ, yerna yeqbel ad yeṭṭef amḍiq n usemmam yettunefken s Windows, ma yella deg tmacint imeɣnasen i yemsefhamen. TPM ur d-yettkel ara belli aselkim ur yeqqim ara ur t-yeǧǧi ara.
Isebtaren-agi ttnadin azday n Synix. Imurar, Steam, Mods, Discord Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren imezwura" Ur d-ternuḍ ara imeslayen neɣ ayen nniḍen iḥulfan deg yismawen n uselkim, yismawen n uselkim, neɣ ismawen n ifaylen n uḍebsi, acku tiɣriwin-a zemren ad d-d-ddment deg uselkim.
14.3 Asebtar n Imḍebbren
- Aseɣwen d uselkim: Isem n umseqdac i d-tefren, asmel n uselkim, tallit n uḍebsi, tilelliwin n tɣellist, hash n wawal n uselkim yeḥzen, taswirt n uselkim yettwaferruyen mi t-yessuffu, isekkilen n useɣwen n uselkim mi t-yessuffu, d yisekkilen n teswiɛt/tmeslayin n tallit. Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usefru: tiɣriwin n umennuɣ ur ttwaḥrezent ara d awalen i d-yettwaqaren. Synix ur d-yettunefki ara tiɣriwin n uḍar-ik, tugna n wudem-ik, amaruḍ privat n usefru, neɣ amaruḍ privat n usefru n useqqamu. Asmel ur d-yettwaḥwaǧ ara isem n tidet neɣ asmel n uselkim. - Tiddukla d tddukla: Taɣawsa n uselkim i d-tefren, amedya n useqdac, asurif-is n tsertit, asuddi n uselmed, amedya n umseqdac n tddukla i d-yettunefken, talɣa n tddukla n tddukla, d lweqt n tddukla iɛedda. Tiddukla n uselmed yettwaḥeqqaren yezmer ad teqqim teffɣelt ma yella yetteddu Synix akken ad d-yesseqdec websayt app-nni i d-yettwakken ɣef tikkelt. Taɣawsa tesɛa isallen n uselmed/tameẓla d imedyaten n tdukli, mačči d idlisen n wurar neɣ tiɣriwin n useqdec. - Amkan i d-yettbanen: Isem n umseqdac, yismawen, ismawen n uḍar, amkan n useḍru, imdanen n yimedyazen, tallit n usebter, lecɣal yellan, tallit/taseḍru n usebter/taseḍru n usebter i d-yewwin CPU d RAM Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " CPU, yettwasseqdacen/tameɣra RAM, d yizerfan n tmeslayit Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tagnit" Isebtaren i sɛan azday IP Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut Taɣawsa-nni tettceggeḍ-d isebtaren-a ma yella tesɛedda tagmuɣli n umseqdac yettwaḥeqqin. CPU/RAM update covers paired computers; Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg uselkim Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer 10 Tiɣriwin nniḍen n usemmiḍen i yettnadiyen zemren ad ṭṭfen tiẓri-nsen iman-nsen. - Isebtaren i d-yettunefken d isekkilen: Isekkilen n uselkim/isekkilen, lweqt n uselkim, talwit/awalen, akked, mi ara d-tunefken tiferwiyin n usekles, isekkilen n usekles, isem n idlisen, wussan, amḍiq, d yisekkilen n tezmert. Ur ttwassen ara ayen yellan deg uḍebsi n yedru d iberdan n umḍiq akk i tmeslayt-a. - Imḍebsiyen n tmeslayt: Amedya n usaru ur nettwali ara, aseɣwen n usekkil i d-yettunefken, d uḍebsi n umḍebsi i d-tessersem. Aḍris i d-yettbanen yettwaferru deg usebter n yedlisen n uxeddim, dɣa yettwaḥeṛṛu seg usebter-nni mi ara d-yefk tlelli. Ur yettwaḥseb ara deg uḍris n lxedma-nni n tura neɣ deg isefra n usebtar n tmucuha. Asefru n usefru yebɣa ad d-yerr umagrad i wurar, mačči d akken urar-nni yeqbel neɣ yekfa-t. Ur tt-id-yessersent ara tiririt n wurar akked ttejra n usebter n umkan. - Taɛziɣt d uḥeṛṛu n tneṣlit: Anagraw n useqdec n tneṣlit, taɛziɣt n uselmed n tneṣlit d lweqt, anagraw n umezgun n uɣawas/tneṣlit, d tiɣriwin n uselkim i d-yellan. Isebtaren i d-yettunefken tiɣriwin n tlelli n usebter yezmer ad ssexdamen isekkilen n tsertit IP d isekkilen n usebter. Isebtaren i d-yettunefken n Synix ur sɛin ara tiɣriwin n useḍfar, idricen n uḍebsi, isura n IP, neɣ tiɣriwin n useḍfar n usemmiḍ. Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg taggayt 14.6.
Asebtar n web yettwaxedmen srid isebtaren i yettunefken d tiɣawsiwin akken ad d-yefk uselmed seg ubrid. HTTPS d tilelliyin n tmeslayin yettwafren ḥulfan azekka-nni deg ubrid; ayagi ur d-yeqqar ara belli taseddawt n usebtar ur tezmir ara ad tesseqdec idammen.
14.4 Taɣawla d usemmiḍ
- Isebtaren n uselmed d isebbaḍen n uselmed qqimen alamma yettwaffɣen uselmed. Isebtaren i d-yettunefken n useqdec qqimen alamma ur yettunefken ara aselkim neɣ ad ttwaḥesben akunt. - Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " CPU / RAM " ttwaɣalen s teɣriwin timaynutin, dɣa uɣalen d imdanen i yettwaqeblen ad tt-nekkren mi d- tewweḍ ddqayeq n " 15 " ur d-teqqel ara. Azal n uḍebsi-nni iɛeddan yeqqim d amkan n usefru n useqqamu. - Isebtaren n uḍebsi, isefra, d meta-daten i d-yettunefken n tlelli n uselmed ad tt-id-yeffɣen i leqder mi ara d-yeffeɣ 24. - Isebtaren i d-yettunefken deg tcewwilt n wurar ad d-yeffɣen s dduklan 30. Aḍris ur d-yefki ara yettwaḥseb i tmuɣli n usemmiḍ mi ara d-yeffeɣ lḥal neɣ mi ara d-yekkes; Taɣawsa yettunefk-itt tesɛa ttwaḥseb ɣef tikkelt. Timeddukla n tmeslayin teffɣen-d deg tlata ddqayeq. Asekkil n tmedyezt d usefru n tseddawit yettwaṭṭafen ttwalin tallit n tmedyezt n 24-it. - Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer 90 Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "100" yesɛan amennuɣ deg yiwen 10-tameḥna n ddqayeq yettwaqqnen. - Timlilit n unadi ttuɣalen-d deffir 30 n ddqayeq mebla tiɣri n uselway neɣ deffir 8 n tsaɛtin s umata. Tiɛriḍin n tmuḥeqranit ad kfun deffir 5 n ddqayeq; Aḥezzeb n wawalen uffir ur nettwaṭṭef ara ad yeffeɣ deg 10 n ddqayeq yerna d win yettwaseqdacen yiwet n tikelt. Tiɣri, tuɣalin, aḥrezzu n uɛawed, d isekkilen i d-yefkan tilelli, ttwakksen deg usizdeg. Tiɣriwin n isekkilen ur nelli ara d tid i d-yettwaḥerzen i usizdeg deffir n 24 n tsaɛtin.
Asebtar-nni yeṭṭef taggara ad yeḥbes aseggwas uqbel ad yettwaḥeṛṛu yiwen n uḍris. Taselkimt n usebter n yedlisen n yedlisen n yedlisen tettwaxdem deg yiswiyen i d-iteddun, maḍi ɣef yiwet n tikkelt yal ddqayect 10 i ttisnift n umseqdac, ihi timsal-nni i d-yellan di tazwara d temsalin n umennuɣ neɣ n ttisnift n ttisnift, mačči d imeslayen n ttesnift deg yiwet n teswiɛt. Isebtaren n umseqdac d tikkunin n usebter tesɛan isekkilen n tudert.
Unpairing yesseffɣel tiɣawsiwin i yettwassnen d yisekkilen-is n uḍrisen i d-yedduklen seg usebter n yedlisen n uxeddim. Ad d-yeqqim umezruy n uḍebber/tunefruḥt deg uselmed ɣef tallit-nni i d-yusan. Aḥric n uselmed n useqdec yettḥeṛṛeb tiɣriwin-is, isekkilen-is, isekkilen-is, imḍebbren-is, d yedlisen n tɣellist n useqdec n useqdec n useqdec n useqdec n useqdec. Ur tessuffɣ ara iserweren n wurar n umezgun-ik, ddunit-ik, imeddukal-ik, neɣ ifaylen n useqdec. Isebtaren i d-yedduklen ɣef umennuɣ n useqdec n tlelli, akk-d isebtaren n usebtar neɣ tiɣriwin n tikli ur ttwaffɣen ara s tikelt s yal yiwet n tɣawsa.
14.5 Isebtaren-ik d ugaraw n usmel
Isebtaren i d-yettunefkan ad d-yefk usefru-inek akked usefru-nni n usebter neɣ aselmed yellan, am Aselmed n Google. Isebtaren i yettwaxedmen akken ad d-yeḥwaǧen snat n tmeslayin ttḥeṭṭlen snat n teḥwaǧin. Tbeddil n usefru, tuffɣa n uselkim s websayt-nni, d tfeǧǧit n usebter n uselkim yessefk ad d-teḥkem tikti tamaynut i usebter-nni.
I wakken ad d-tekkseḍ aselkim n urar, ilaq-ak daɣen ad d-tefkeḍ awal uffir n ukawnt-ik, yerna ilaq-ak-d ad tesqedceḍ tikci-nniḍen i d-yettunefken i uselkim-ik. Aseɣti-nni yeqqen ɣer yiwet n temlilit n useqdac, aselkim yettwaqqnen, aselkim yettwaḥerzen d urar n wurar srid armi d tlata n ddqayeq. Aḥbes, rnu-d abrid, sekkseḍ akunsil, asebded n akunsil yettwakkes neɣ aswir ixuṣṣen ur d-yettunefk ara. Asekles neɣ usekcem n tkarḍa n umḍebber ad yekfu aseɣẓan n tkarḍa-ya. Tiɣawsiwin n uḥeddad n uqeddac ad ḥerzen tiɣawsiwin-nsen i yellan yakan. D isebtaren n usekcem n wurar kan i yettwaqeblen i yzemren; Asenfar amaynut weḥd-s ur d-yettak ara azref i tira ɣer usefru n usebded Windows.
Aselkim i d-yettunefken yezmer ad d-yefk asebtar n tallit ma tettuḍ asebtar n websayt-ik. Ur yezmir ad d-yettefki asebter nniḍen. Ameslay n teswiɛt ur t-yessuffu ara neɣ ur t-yekkes ara ayen i d-yeḥwaǧen imeslayen-ik n usefru/umeslay, yerna ilaq ad tefreḍ ameslay amaynut uqbel ad tkecmeḍ ameslay. Tameqqra n tuɣalin tessexdem-d tiɣriwin nniḍen n useqdec-ik.
Amseqdac n Synix yettḥerrez taggayt n usmel n useqdec-is deg tmeɣra n umeslay, mačči di cookies, deg unagraw amkan neɣ deg unagraw. Ad d-tessuffuḍ neɣ ad t-tesseqceḍ tab-nni, ad tt-teǧǧeḍ tikli-nni. Ayagi ur yeǧǧi ara ad d-yettunefken usebter-ik neɣ amseqdac n wawalen n tsertit-ik ad d-yeffɣen isekkilen ma tebɣiḍ, yerna ur d-yessawal ara cookies i d-yessersen s taḥala s wid i d-yedduklen deg usebter n usebter/s tɣellist neɣ s usebter n tsuqilt n useqdec n websit.
Tzemreḍ ad teffɣeḍ, ad tɛawḍeḍ tiɣriwin n usemmiḍ neɣ ad t-tekkseḍ aselkim. Asmel n Synix amḍiq yezmer ad yeqqel u ad yeqqel tilellit-is s tuɣult ur d-yettkel ara ɣer usebtar. Asmi ara d-yeffɣen, ad yeqqel azruf seg uḍris s umḍiq n tmurt yerna ad yettnadi daɣen ad yeffeɣ websayt mi ara yili yiwet n tlelli. Asebtar n usebter n useqdec neɣ Windows ur d-yessuɣal ara s tdukli i d-yekkes srid. Mazal-d useqdac amkan kan.
14.6 Aseddam, Isebtaren i d-yeffɣen i medden akk-d Limer n tezmert
Asebtar n usebtar n usebtar yettqeddim Sites hosting n OpenAI d uxeddim Cloudflare i usefru, umezgun, tɣellist, akked usebtar n usebtar. Isebtaren-agi ttwaxedmen tiɣriwin i yettwaḥwaǧen akken ad d-fken isefka-yagi, yerna zemren ad d-fken tiɣriwin n IP, ad ssutren isekkilen, lweqt, d imedyaten nniḍen n tdukli, neɣ ad ḥadrent idlisen-nsen n uxeddim akked tikliwin n tikliwin. Timsirin-nsen n tsertit ttɛeddun ɣef uselkim-nsen: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ d https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Tafsirt taselkimt n usebter aɣelnaw d tmeslayin n GitHub ttwaxedmen i umseqdac-nsen. Amseqdac privat yettwaḥesben seg isebtaren i d-yeffɣen, ur yeṭṭef ara amseqdac n tsuqilt i d-yeffɣen neɣ isebtaren n tmeslayt. Synix ur d-yettarra ara awal ameqran i wakken ad d-teddun kra n yisebtaren ur d-yefki ara cookies, isebtaren, neɣ idden yettwaḥaznen. Isebtaren ad d-nnan daɣen ma yella yettwaḥwaǧen s wudem uselway; Taɣawsa-nni i d-yeddun deg umagrad-a ur t-yeǧǧi ara ad d-tessuffeq yiwen n usebter neɣ ad d-yefken s wudem yeṣfan.
Synix yettqeddim timlilit i d-yettunefkan, iswiyen n uselkim yettwaffirmen, tdukliwin n useqqamu yettwaferruzen, uḍebsiwen n uḍebsi n usekles, d tiɣawsiwin n kra n lweqt akken ad ɛeṭṭel uḍebsi ur yettunefk ara tezmert. Tiɣriwin-agi ur tt-yeǧǧan ara ad d-yettuneffu uḍris n usebter seg wemḍiq neɣ ur t-yeǧǧan ara ad yettuneffu ɣef yal uguren, amaru/tameẓla yeɣlanen, tilelliyin n teswiɛt i yettwakksen, neɣ axeddim yeɣlanen. Qqim Synix d Windows i d-yessufɣen, ḥadret akkwunt-inek d tilelliyin n usemmiḍ, ḥadret isekkilen d akkwunt-ik kan i tesɛam.
Asebtar-a d ameɣnas ɣef https://synix.info/license/ yettwaḥric deg Centre n Useɣwen d uselkim n uselmed. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer https://synix.info/support/. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tameẓla"

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Isebtaren i yellan ddaw-a sɛan aseɣwen:
Ssefk-as ad d-yeqqel ugur Ssebtaren-d uselmed n tsertit, tifirin n Synix d Windows i tesqedceḍ s tidet, wurar/amaru, d timsal n uḍebsi/tunefki.
Smekti: • Ayen i d-tbeddeḍ neɣ i d-beddleḍ. • D acu i d-teţṛaǧuḍ d acu yeḍran. • Taɣawsa-nni akk-d yiwen n uḥric amecṭuḥ n temsalt i d-yewweḍ lweqt-is. • D acu i d-ibeddlen, d acu i d-ibeddlen.
Aḥric uqbel ad d-ternuḍ Ssufɣet imeslayen n usebtar, tiɣriwin, URL n webhook, iberdan n wemdan, d isallen n tkebbanit ur tebɣiḍ ara ad d-teffɣemt. Amkan n tsertit ur yeḥrez ara yal adlis i d-yedduklen. Ur t-id-ternuḍ ara isekkilen n uḍar neɣ tilelliwin n wurar s tuɣalin-nsen.
I usebter n tessuqlit, ssmel-d tutlayt i d-yefren, isem n ṭṭaq, akk-d tifyar i d-yettban s tidet. I ugur n tsekla n wurar, include a redacted installation layout and the relevant game documentation.
TAMURT TAMURT Isebtaren i sɛan azday: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Community Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Adlis n usenfar: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Taɣawsa n usebter yettwassnen ur tezmir ad tesɛuḍ yal urar, amud, d uḥric n useqqamu. Tiɣriwin n tuffra i d-yettɛawin ad d-yeffer ugur n Synix seg ugur n wurar neɣ n usnulfu n uselway.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Sseqceṛ yiwet n tzeṭṭa n uselkim uqbel ad tesqedceḍ tilelliyin deg uḍar. Tazrawt i d-yettwaferren tettwalin d acu n uselkim i d-yeḍran ccɣel.
Ufi-d aqeddac Sseqdec tasruft n uḍar akken ad tessufeḍ s yisem n wurar neɣ d isem n uselkim. Aḥric n usemmiḍ i d-yessekker adlis-nni ugar. Ma yella yettban-d yiwen n usebter yeǧǧa-t, sseffɣet snat n isefra uqbel ad d-tettwaliḍ d win i tt-yessuffɣen.
Ɣṛeḍ tagmuct • Isebtaren i d-yettunefken ttḥesben tiɣriwin n umseqdac i d-yeṭṭfen. • Running Now yettban-d tiɣriwin i d-yettunefkan akka tura d tiɣriwin. • CPU Usage and RAM Ameslay ad d-yesseqdec PC akk, mačči kan Synix. • Isebtaren n umurar llan ttwassen kan mi ara d-yefken uḍar yettwaferren taṣebḥit i d-yettunefken.
TAMURT TAGWALT • Start, Stop, and Restart administer the selected server. • Ad d-yeffreḍ uḍar n usebter-is. • Taseɛda tettɛeẓra tiɣriwin i yezmer ad t-yeḥbes. • Teddukla n Serveur tesɛa tiɣriwin n idlisen, n useqdec, n tdukli, d tiɣriwin i d-yellan ɣef urar. • Tcekk-d snat tikliyin deg yiwet n tegrawt akken ad teẓreḍ aserwer-nni s tɣawsa.
Tasɣunt & Dyagnostikt tessawal-d unaru d tmuɣliwin i d-yeqqaren. Aql-d awal i d-yeffɣen uqbel ad d-ternuḍ tikli. CLEAR yettḥeṛṛu lqaɛa n lxedma yettbanen; Mačči d tagga i d-yettunefk ad tfeǧǧeḍ akk idlisen n usebter.
Ur d-yefk ara ad yelhu yiwen n uselmed i imurar. Ad tt-id-yesseqdec, ad d-yesseqdec deg umaḍal, ad d-yesseqdec umennuɣ, ad t-yesseqdec deg urar mi d-yeffeɣ yiwen n uḥric. Ass-d akken i d-teqqareḍ deg usebter n ccɣel s tdukli.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Open Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager i uselmed yettwaḥkem. Synix yettwalin ayen i d-yettunefken d imahilen i yettwaɛǧeb; Mačči d asebter yesɛan yal asmel.
INSTALL A LOCAL PACKAGE 1. Ssebba n yedrimen n umaḍal, add-ons i yellan, d uḍebsi yettwaṭṭfen. 2. Ḥebseḍ aselkim-nni ɣer Synix, ttraǧu ad d-yeffeɣ umussu-ines. 3. Ẓer aselkem n add-on i d-yefkan, amḍiq n tkecmeḍ, d uḍris n tɣellist. 4. Select Install From File or Import Package for a supported file, ZIP, or complete mod folder. Tiferriwin i d-yeffɣen ttbanen ɣef uselmed n umennuɣ. 5. Ẓer taɣiwant-nni, ssebba n useqdec, inebgazen, d aseqqamu. 6. Ad d-yeffɣeḍ, ad d-yeffɣeḍ, ad d-yeffɣeḍ. 7. Synix yettɛessas adlis-nni mi yekfa tkecmet. Rnu-t ma yella tebɣiḍ, dɣa ẓer taggayt n wurar d tdukli n uselkim.
Asebtar-nni yettwalin amḍiq n tsertit i d-yefren. Sseqdec Aseqdec akken ad d-tafeḍ add-on s yisem, amaru, usebter neɣ abrid. Yesskan-d tikkelt nniḍen, yettḥerrez taɣawsa i d-yefren mi mazal-it. Taswiɛt i d-yessersen teffed kra n temsalt tecniḥt, ur ttuɣalin ara tikliwin.
Qqimen ṭṭaq-nni d amecṭuḥ, mi ara d-tesskan neɣ ad d-yebeddel. Synix yettḥebbes tiɣawsiwin i d-yeffɣen alamma teqqel. Ma yella kra n tɣawsa ur d-teffɣel ara, ɣṛeḍ tafekka-nni-ines, rnu-t deg uḍris-nni uqbel ad tɛerḍeḍ tikkelt nniḍen.
TAMURTEN n uḍebsi n leqdic Isebtaren i yettunefken: Minecraft JAR packages, Rust Oxide/uMod plugins, 7 Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer lmut ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, d ARK: Survival Ascended provider IDs. Llan kra n tkeṛṛuyin i d-yettwakksen kan neɣ ttwaḥwaǧen azref-nsen d amezwaru.
I izerfan n umseqdac, Synix yettḥaddam tiɣriwin i yettwaɛǧeben mi ara d-yefki udem/umseqdac uguren. Ur yezmir ara ad d-yesskan uqbel wayen ur d-yettunefkarent ara.
D acu i zemren d ayen ur zmiren ara leqdic Imudalen ttḥeqqaren tafyirt n uḍebsiyen d yimkan, ttḥeṛṛben iberdan ur neǧhid ara, isekkilen, ayen ur yettunefk ara ad yettwaxdem, imukan meqqren, imukan n tdukliyin, d tufiwin i d-yesseknen n usefru.
Aseqsi n Defender ur d-yewwi ara neɣ ur d-yefhim ara, d asirem, mačči d aseɣru n uḍebsi. Ula d uskan n tlelli d uḍebsi yettwaṭṭfen ur d-yefki ara belli taserdut n terbaɛt i d-yettunefk laman. Mods teddun s yizerfan Windows n uselkim.
TAMURT, TAMURT, D TAMURT Browse Catalog yettɣel websayt n umseqdac. Ur d-yeffu ara tiɣawsiwin s automatik neɣ ur d-yettunefki ara amḍebber n yimuddiyen.
Ssewwet aselkim uqbel ad d-ternuḍ tiɣriwin. D aya i d-yessufuɣen akk uḍebsi yettwaferren, yezmer ad yesɛu aṭas n yigerdan. Yeqqel i d-yettunefken imezwura yettwaḥebsen, yessexdem idlisen i d-yeddun s usefru-nni. Ssebtar i d-yettunefken deg usebtar, Synix yugi ad yessuqel idlisen i d-yettbeddlen deg wayen ur nelli ara s usebter-is yettwaḥric neɣ ad yesqedceḍ isalen yettwaḥrisen i d-yexḍaren ma yella ur d-yefki ara teswiɛt-nsen n tiddukla. Isebtaren imeqranen i d-yettunefken ur yezmir ara ad yesɛu hashs i yemsalen yettwaḥrez.
I uselkim n useqdac, Remove Selected yesqedceɣ aselkim-nni seg uselkim yettwaɛǧeb n Synix; Mačči d asebter n lbaṭel i d-yettwaṭṭfen deg tmurt. Synix yeṭṭef-d imeddal i d-yettxeddem, mačči d yal amedya n uḍebsi. Ɣur-k tiɣriwin n uḍebsi n uselkim: ad tkecmeḍ yiwen n uselkim i yezmer ad t-id-yeǧǧ ddunit neɣ ad tkecmeḍ ayen yellan deg uselkim-nni.
Aɣmis yeččuṛen d ulac add-ons i yettwaɛǧeben i d-yeqqnen ɣer uḍris n usebter d usebter i d-yettwasemren. Sseqceṛ Afaru, ẓer amaru, amḍal, d usebter uqbel ad d-tiniḍ akk ifayel yellan deg disk i yettwaḥḍaren.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Abrid Add Server → Game Support Catalog akken ad teẓreḍ d acu i yeẓra Synix ɣef urar uqbel ad d-tnulfu asebtar. Adlis-nni yessexdamen isebtaren i d-yettunefken deg uselmed-inek.
1. Ttnadi ɣef yisem n wurar. 2. Sseqdec ifiltren n tlelli, iddaten n umedyaz, tiɣriwin n usebter, n umeddakel, neɣ n uḍebsi akken ad tesɛuḍ tabrat-nni. 3. Ffer-d urar, ldi isallen-is, neɣ kki-d snat n tikkal ɣef tseddart-is. 4. Ɣeṛ asebter i yettwasuḍan, usenfar n uselkim, isefra, d isallen n uḥric.
Sseffɣet ifiltren ma yella ur d-yettwali ara wurar. Minecraft's Java and Bedrock's choices are part of its setup workflow, and not two interchangeable mod systems.
Qqareḍ iẓuran-ik s lxiṛ Amaru yezmer ad d-yefken asebter yettwaselmen, asnulfu yettwaḥkem, iseddin n usebtu, neɣ asuter amecṭuḥen/azal. Asebtar n "Steam AppID" i d-yettunefken amek tettxeddem tkecmet; Ur d-yettḥeqqeḍ ara yal asekkil n uḍar.
Aḥwaǧ n SteamCMD yettwaḥesben yeqqar-d ad d-yefk uselmed i useqdec n tmeslayt. Tamɣart n wurar d uḍrisen n umessufeɣ yezmer ad d-yefk kra nniḍen.
TAMURT TAMURRITTA mačči d asebter n tmes Aḥric n tmeslayt n useqdec ur d-yettban ara belli yella yiwen n umeslay n tmeslayt neɣ ilaq ad yettwassen. Sseqdec asebter n wurar d tiɣriwin n usenfar.
Amaru d amḍiq i d-yettwaḥḍaren isebtaren i d-yettwassen. Isebtaren n uḍebsi n temsirin i d-yettbanen deg uselkim-a, ur d-yefki ara iswiyen n yal tkeṛṛust neɣ n yimedyazen.

TAMURT TAMURT Imaskaren n usebter n tsertit ssɛan afellaḥ, am tiɣriwin d tmeslayin. Ur tbeddil ara IP-inek amḍal, ur d-yettwaffer ara uḥric n useqqamu, neɣ ur d-yeččuṛ ara yal adlis n wurar akked usefru n tdukli.

TAMURTEN D TAMURTEN Synix yettḥaseb imeslayen i d-yettunefken, isekkilen, d tiɣriwin n webhook i umseqdac n Windows n tura. Ad d-yeḥwaǧ urar i yettwaxedmen deg tkeṛṛust-is neɣ deg uḍris n usebter.
Aḍris n ufaylu amaynut ɣer usebter-iḍen n Windows ur d-yettak ara tiɣawsiwin-a yettwaḥerzen ad zemrent ad d-tekksent. Seqdec axeddim n usiweḍ s tuffra i usiweḍ n tmusniwin yettwaqeblen.

Tiɣriwin n tmeslayin n tmeslayin n tmeslayin i d-yettunefken tiɣriwin n Synix. Reẓdem tiɣriwin i d-yettwaxedmen uqbel ad t-tessefk tifrat. Ur d-yeḥkem ara yal amḍebber n uselmed neɣ ur d-yeǧǧ ara ad ttweḥrez tiɣriwin n firewall ur nesɛi ara azal.
Ma yella yettwassen yiwen n usefru, beddlet-t neɣ ruḥet-t deg uselmed i t-yefkan. Lqern n uḍris n Synix yettwaffer neɣ ad t-yeffɣen, ur d-yekkes ara tazmert-nni anda nniḍen.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Abrid isefka n uselkim yettwaferran n uselkim n usebter i wakken ad d-tessineḍ tawsit i d-yeǧǧan. Taɣawsa n umennuɣ i d-yettunefkan s Synix ur tettwaṭṭef ara tiɣawsiwin n uḍar.
DLL MESSING DLL MESSAGS Isebtaren i sɛan azday MSVCP140.dll neɣ VCRUNTIME140.dll s waṭas i d-yettmeslayen ɣer kra n temsalt n Visual C++. Sseqdec isebtaren n wurar d usemmiḍ yettwaṭṭfen Microsoft.
Isebtaren i d-yettwaqeblen ɣer Microsoft: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Ur ilaq ara ad tbedduḍ idlisen DLL n yiwen n wemdan seg yiberdan n usebter neɣ ur ilaq ara ad tbedduḍ DLL ur nelli ara ɣer tama n useqdec n uselkim.
ICEQWEN-nniḍen Amur yezmer ad yeḥwaǧ yiwen n usebtar, azref n umseqdac, tallit n uḍar n Java, azal n Windows, neɣ unnar yettwaḥwaǧen. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "
I Minecraft Java, seqdec taggayt n tsuqilt/tameẓla yettwaqeblen seg yiminigen n Synix. Bedrock ur yesseqdac ara Java.
Akken ad d-ternu yiwen n uselmed i yeḥwaǧen Hyper-V neɣ aḥric n uḍar, ẓer isekkilen-is n tteswiɛt ɣef urar-is. Ur t-id-tesseqdec ara timura n uselkim neɣ ur t-id-teddun ara yal aserwer d amḍar akken kan ad t-id-teǧǧeḍ taḥsebt.
Mi d-yettunefk lḥal, ssexdem yiwet n tebdawt tamaynut, yerna rnu-d taɣawla tamezwarut i d-yettunefken deg usebter n urar, ma mazal-it yexser.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
TAMURT TAMURT TAMURT:
1. Synix yettɣellel amseqdac n uselkim i d-yettunefkan i Space Engineers yerna yezga yettban-it.
2. Select 'Local/Console', select 'Continue to server configuration', tseddmeḍ isebtaren n uselkim d umaḍal, dɣa seleq 'Save & start'.
3. Sseqdec amḍebrir n uselkimen i d-yedduklen, ddunit, mods, imḍebbiren, d tmeslayt. Isebtaren n umseqdac ttwaḥerzen di daxel n useqdec-a Synix Instance.
4. Local/Console amkan n uqerruy ur yeḥwaǧ ara izerfan n uselkim. Windows service mode yes.
5. Taɣriwin: .NET Framework 4.8 neɣ ugar, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 d 2017, ma ulac 6 GB n ubrid RAM, d UDP taɣiwant 27016 yeǧǧa-d ad iɛeddi Windows D tafyirt n tmeslayin, d tin i d-yettunefkan i imeɣnasen n Internet.
6. Asebtar amasiḥan: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5CA69EB89BDD805145B9
data.value: Open Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg and set use g_console "1". Ssebbu-d urar n Euro Truck Simulator 2 amaynut, tkecmeḍ amaruḍ-ik d lmapt-ik, tsusfeḍ ~ akken ad d-teffreḍ taselkimt, dɣa tessexdem export_server_packages. Sserreḍ urar-nni, dɣa tselleḍ Start deg Synix tikkelt nniḍen. Synix ad d-yessufeɣ ifayel i d-yettunefken s ttawil.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Sseqdec aselmed-a mi yella ccɣel n usaru n LAN, maca ur d-yettili ara usaru n tmeslayt.
TAMURT-ik n tmeslayt n medden Llan kra n yimeslayen ur sseknen ara NAT loopback, yettusemnan daɣen hairpinning. Tameẓla seg daxel n uxxam ɣer tmeslayt-is i d-yeffɣen, tezmer ad teɣli ula ma llan imeddukal n berra.
Sseqdec tamsalt n LAN deg uxxam, ssut i win yellan s Internet nniḍen ad yeɛreḍ tamsalt-nni. Tameẓla n WAN i d-yeffɣen deg uselkim ur d-tekki ara iman-is d asebter n uḍebsi n Internet.
Asiweḍ n yipurtan ur ibeddel kra Ttxil-k ad d-teẓreḍ yiwen n uselkim nniḍen i d-yetteddun, NAT amedyazen, neɣ NAT (CGNAT) n useqdec. Smekti tamsalt n WAN n uselkim akked tmeslayt tadelsant, ssut i ISP ma ttwaḥasben tilelliyin i d-iteddun.
Tawsit n usebter deg ubrid-ik ur yezmir ad d-yesselḥu NAT yettwaḥkemen s ISP. Ad d-yefk yiwen n uselmed n tmeslayt, VPN/tunnel yelhan, neɣ server yeṭṭfen. Tagi d tilelliyin n beṛṛa, mačči d tilelliwin n Synix i d-yedduklen.
Ur ttuɣaleḍ ara taselkimt d uḍar n imseqdacen Tiddukla-nni n tlelli d tddukla-nni n umurar n urar d iberdan i yeffɣen. Asebtar n API neɣ Discord n tmurt ur d-yeǧǧi ara ad d-yettunefk uḥric seg Internet.
Ɣur-ak akk usebter n uḍris n tkebbanit i d-yettunefqeṛ ɣer tmeslayt d uḍris n urar. Ur d-tessuffeḍ ara imeslayen n uselmed, tiɣriwin, tugniwin n uselkim, neɣ isebtaren n useqdec privat mi ara tessutrem afus.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Sseqdec asebter-nni i d-yeqqnen ɣer usebter i yeɣlin.
TAMURT n SYNIX Activity & Diagnostics d-yettwalin tiɣriwin d isebtaren n umseqdac i d-yeffɣen deg uḍar. Asebtar n uselmed Ur tessuffɣen ara akk tiɣriwin i d-yettwassen.
LOGES n useqdec Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Synix" C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Ameslay n usemmiḍ yezmer ad d-yefk isem i useqdec n usefru. Sseqdec abrid-nni d lweqt n usemmi ur d-yufiḍ ara tafyirt-nni i d-yellan.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usefru n uḍris: Taɣawsa yettwaṭṭfen deg uḍris ur d-tesseknu ara s yiman-is ad d-yeɣli uselmed.
LLEGGES n wurar Sseqdec usefru n urar n umennuɣ i d-yettwaferren akken ad d-ternuḍ tiɣriwin n umaḍal, tiɣriwin, mod, d tikerkasen n umennuɣ n urar. Amkan-is yeqqen ɣef wurar, yezmer ad yili di beṛṛa n tẓuri n usebter.
TAWATTIT deg umyag Ḥadret ayen i d-yexdem d lweqt, dɣa ẓer isallen i d-yellan deg umennuɣ amezwaru. Aḥric n usekkil deg taggara yezmer ad yili d ayen i d-yefkan mačči d ssebba.
Qbel ad tcebbeḍ asebter, kkes awal uffir, isekkilen, isebtaren n usmel, tansawin tiḥersiyin d yiberdan n umdan. Satisfactory tezmer ad tesɛu tasɣunt n umḍebber. Eǧǧ aɣmis-nni aneggaru n tnezzut i tɣawsa-k.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Ad d-yesseɣleḍ ayen yellan deg uselmed n useqdec yettwafren. Select the correct server and preserve anything newer before proceeding.
1. Ḥebseḍ aselkim-nni, u kker-d afrux n idlisen iɛeddan i teţwaḥwaǧeḍ. 2. Efk uselmed n uxeddim n uɣawas (Restore backup workflow) deg Isebtaren n useqdec. 3. Ffer asaru-nni i tebɣiḍ, rnu-d aqeddac-is, ass-is, tadrimt-is, d talɣa-s n tuqqna. 4. Ẓer-it uqbel ad d-tesseḥbed. Synix backups with SHA-256 isekkilen yezmer ad yettwaḥseb ɣef isekkilen-nni; yezmer ad yettwasemmar arrac imeqqranen d taɛdawt. 5. Ɣṛas-d awal n umennuɣ n umennuɣ, u kkes-d kan ma d aya i tebɣiḍ. 6. Ad d-yeǧǧ ad yekfu usebter n uḍar akked uselmed s tuffra n Synix neɣ ad t-id-yekkes umkan. 7. Sbeddem aselkim-nni, tesɛuḍ ad d-tessekcem ddunit i d-yettwaferran.
D acu i d-yefkan usebter Aḍris n tlelli i d-yefkan tizmura deg umata. Ur d-yettban ara belli yiwen n ddunit yella yeṣfan mi yettwasellek neɣ ma yella yiwen n wemḍan i d-yeffɣen seg wayeḍ, d ayen yesɛan laman.
MAY-YETTAWT TAMURT Ɣur-k lkarayf d wayen akk i d-yettuneqqen neɣ i d-yettuneqqen. Ɣṛeḍ awal n uselmed uqbel ad ternuḍ ad d-ternuḍ neɣ ad tessufuḍ idlisen nniḍen.
Ur tessufeɣ ara ZIP ɣef uselkim yetteddun. Ma yella ur d-yeqqim ara uḍebsi n wurar di beṛṛa n tfaska n usekles, rnu-t s talɣa n wurar yettwaɛawan.
Ɣur-k asebter n tazwara alamma teḍreḍ aserwer i d-yeqqlen akked tlelli n uselkim.

data.name: Content.730545B3639C062E1741
