data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Import Existing Server yeṭṭef-d taggayt i yettwaseklen yellan yakan deg disk. Mačči d asmi ara d-yessuqel, yerna yewɛeṛ ɣer usebter n uḍebsi n useqdec n Synix.
Qbel ad d-tessuffeḍ Sseqdec asebter n uḍebsi ɣef yiman-is, deg wayen akk i d-yettunefken di beṛṛa n useqqamu n usekles. Ḥebseḍ aselkim-nni, ḥebseḍ amɛellem neɣ ameskar nniḍen i yezmer ad t-id-yessnulfu mi ara t-id-yerr Synix.
REGRISTAYEN TAMURT 1. Select Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Ffer afaylu n usebded n uqeddac s tidett, mačči afaylu n uẓeṭṭa, afaylu ZIP, neɣ afaylu n uqeddac n urar. 3. Awi i Synix ad t-iẓer, imir-a ad d-tesɛuḍ ad d-tessineḍ ccna yettwasnen, edition, exécutable, d iseddin. 4. Efk-d isem n usebter i d-yeǧǧan deg-s yiwen n yisem, yerna tesqedceḍ isefra akk i yeǧǧan. 5. Sqedceḍ ad d-tessuffuḍ, fkeḍ Amkan, yerna rnu abrid-is d yifiran-is. 6. Sseqdec Tayla, dɣa ssexdem yiwet n tebdawt yettwaḥkem. Ttxil-k ad d-tiniḍ d acu i t-id-yefkan.
D acu i d-ibeddilen Asmelli ur yeǧǧi ara tkeṛṛust, ur tt-yekkes ara d tikelt nniḍen neɣ ur yettbeddil ara ifaylen n umennuɣ-is. Isebtaren i d-yettbeddlen deg umezruy, am Tineggura, Tameẓla, neɣ Assewwi n uselmed, zemren ad beddlent ifayilen.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tawsift" Ur yezmir ad d-yettwaḥseb yiwen n ubrid n tkecmeḍ snat tikwal.
IF DETECTION FAILS Ttxil-k ad tɛawḍem ma telliḍ yiwet n tsertit n useqdec i yettwaɣalen s uselmed i d-yefren. Ur tessuqel ara isem n yiwen n uselmed ur nezmir ara ad d-yettunefk. Rnu-d adlis-nni d usebter n useqqamu yettwaɣalen akken ad d-tessfehmeḍ tifrat-is.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Sseqdec aselmed-a mi ara d-yernu umedyaz n tneḍra i d-yeǧǧan uḥric yettwaḥkem, taɣnit ur d-tettili ara neɣ yiwen n usebter ur neqqil ara.
Fhem ayen i d-yefren • Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer taggayt • Tameẓla tessexdem yiwen n ugur i d-yettunefken. • Asnulfu yettaru-d isebtaren n uselmed yerna yezmer ad yekkes tilelliyin i d-yettunefken.
Asebtar ur yelli d aswir amezwaru i yal akayad n uselkim. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tameẓla"
Qbel ad nernu Ḥebseḍ urar-nni, ḥadret yiwet n tefsut ur ttwaḥesben ara n idlisen i d-yeṭṭfen, u ɣṛeḍ asmi ara tettbeddil akken ilaq. Llan kra n yimedyazen yesɛan isebtaren ifukklen; wiyaḍ ttṛaǧun ad d-tessufeɣ urar deg tikelt tamezwarut, neɣ ad teḥwaǧ ad d-teqqimeḍ s ufus.
Synix i d-yettmeslayen ur nesɛi ara tiɣriwin i yettwaḥwaǧen, mačči akken ad d-yeqbel ad yerr yal tawsit s tɣellist. S useqdec n usebter n usebter i yettwaselmen yezmer ad d-yeḥrez yiwet n tefsut yiwet n tikelt isem-is .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
Mi d-yeffɣen neɣ mi d-yettunefken Ɣur-d isefka n usebter neɣ n tuɣalin d teɣri n uselmed n tuɣalin. Qqbel ad d-tefremt acu ara d-tesnulfuḍ, qbel ad tgerḍem asebter amezwaru d wayen i d-yebeddel. Ur tessufuḍ ara adlis s waṭas n tikwalen i d- tessexdimeḍ Reset.
Mi ara d-ternu, bdu yiwet n tikelt, ẓṛeḍ adlis-nni n wurar. Ẓer ma yella yeɣra abrid-nni n tidet, yerna mazal-it uḍebsi-nni i d-yeḥwaǧen.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune yessexdem yiwen n uselkim n useqdec i d-yettunefkan s tmacint tavirtualt i d-yeṭṭfen deg urar akked talɣa n tdukli. Mačči d aserwer n wurar amaynut.
TAMURT Ɣṛeḍ-d tiɣriwin n usizegzawen n Synix i usmekti n uselkim, AVX2, tiswirin n uḥeddar, Hyper-V, d yiwet n tefyirt n Windows i d-yettunefken s usekkil Professional neɣ ɛlayen. Iḥwaǧen n tmekti ttwaxedmen ɣef terbaɛt-nni n umennuɣ d tkartiwin i tessexdem.
Synix ur d-yettunefk ara s tsusmi n tmucuha neɣ ad yers Hyper-V. Ternu-d isefra imezwura n wurar uqbel ad ternuḍ.
asbeddi d usnulfu 1. Ssebba-d asebter n Dune: Awakening, rnu-t i teḥwaǧin-is akk-d tfaska-s n usekles. 2. Rnu-t, bdu-t. 3. Synix yettbeddil azref n battlegroup.bat ameskar s usebter n umedyaz i d-yettwaḥwaǧ uselmed-nni. 4. Select initial-setup deg uḍar n wurar ad d-tessefkeḍ asekkil-inek s yiman. 5. Sqedceḍ asnulfu n tmeslayt, n uḍar, d taqqimt n umennuɣ deg usebter-nni.
Ad d-tawiḍ asekkil n Self-Host s usebter n tmeslayt n Funcom s useqdec n usekkil-is/ usekkil-is: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Ɣur-k ad teffɣeḍ taẓuri-nni. Taɣawsa n uḍar-agi n useqdec ur d-teqqil ara belli yal aserwer n Synix ilaq ad yetteddu d amseqdac.
TAMURTEN n uḍebsi d uselkim Seqdec asebter n usmel n umḍebber/VM s tidet n useqdec d yiberdan ilaqen. Metadata n usseqsi deg Synix d RMQ, mačči d win yesmeḥsisen aseqsi A2S.
Tazewwurt n tmeslayt yettwaferren ur d-tesbeggin ara belli tmeslayin-is n tmeslayt ḥebsen. Ssebba ɣef umennuɣ n uḍar, xeddmet lxedma n tdukli s uselkim n useqdec n wurar.
Synix yezmer ad d-yesseqdec, ad d-yesseqdec, ad d-yesseqdec, ad d-yessufeɣ, yerna ad d-yessufeḍ amaru n tseddilt i d-yefren. Ur ttxemmimeḍ ara asekkil n uḥeddim amaynut, tiɣriwin n imseqdacen, neɣ ad d-yettunefki umedyaz akken iwata ɣef usebter n tefyirt. Ur yettunefk ara ad d-yessufuɣ amaru n usebtar i useqdec-a.
Sseqdec tiwtilin n useggem d useggem sɣur urar i yiminigen n VM/taḍeft n isefka. ZIP n ufaylu n useqdec weḥd-s ur d-yettili ara d aseɣẓan n tuqqna yettwafeṣlen.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Asebter-agi d i yimseqdacen d imeddukal imeqqranen. Ur teḥwaǧeḍ ara tilelliyin n umussu akken ad d-tnulfuḍ aserwer seg unamek i yettwasemmaren.
Amek i ttxeddmen tiɣriwin Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg wurar ttmeslayen ɣef tsuqilin, izedganen, Steam AppIDs d tiɣriwin n useqdec, isefra n usebter, iɣirman, tikli n tkebbanit, tiɣriwin, d tiɣriwin n uselkim.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut Ur tt-id-yefken ara s tmusni i imseqdacen, i d-yedduklen, neɣ iskripten i d-yettwazzalen. Aḍeggu n usefru JSON ɣer useqdec n uḍebsi yettwassen ur d-yesseknu ara amaru amaynut n wurar.
TAMURT neɣ TAMURT 1. Bdan-d s isefra n uselkim n uselkim ameqqran d ifayilen n umennuɣ i d-yessnulfan s tidet. 2. Sseqdac iberdan i d-iqqanen ɣer uḍar n useqdec anda ilaq d isekkilen n umennuɣ i d-yettmeslayen. 3. Ssebba n wungal i d-yettunefkan deg yiberdan-nsen. 4. Asebtar amaynut 5. Ssebba n usefru, bnu s SDK i d-yeḥwaǧ usenfaṛ-nni, yerna tessexdem ismektayen i d-yellan. 6. Aḍar n usebter, tazwara, taggara, d uḍar s wurar n tidet qbel ad d-yettuneqdec umennuɣ.
Definition Builder d aseɣwen n usebter n usebter, mačči d talɣa tamaneɣt n usebter n usebter.
TAMURT n usebter • UI • ServerHandler: Imḍebbren n urar d tdukliwin n uselkim. • SynixEngine: Taɣawsa n tudert n uselmed, uguren, useqdec n yizerfan, isekkilen, d tilelli. • Tameẓla: Tameẓla i d-yettunefken, temsirin, d wid i d-yesseknen. • Database/GameDefinitions: Isebtaren n wurar d isalen. • Database/ModSystems: Isebtaren i d-yettunefken n leqdic add-on. • Taɣremt: Isebtaren i d-yettunefken n useqdec d imseqdacen. • Tiḍriwin: Tiḍriwin i d-yettunefken ɣef temsirin.
I tmeslayin, rnu-d yal amḍebber n tutlayin d yiwen deg-sen yerna ḥadret imazighen. Ssarem-d isebtaren n umɛawed, tiɣriwin n usemmiḍ, tira i d-yettunefkan, d timmalin i d-yettunefken urar. Ur tessuqleḍ ara imḍebbren, tiɣriwin, isekkilen, azal n umseqdac, neɣ isekkilen i d-yettwassnen. Isebtaren imezwura n usemmiḍ ur ttbeddilen ara.
Qqareḍ tiɣriwin n tlelli d tmeslayt uqbel ad tesbedduḍ afaylu neɣ tiɣriwin. Ɣur-k idlisen n tidet d isebtaren n wemdan i d-yeffɣen seg isefka d usebter.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Ssebba-d aɣmis n uḥassas n uselkim kan mi ara teḍreḍ tikli-s tamaneɣt, azdayu, ḥebseḍ, d tebda.
1. Abrid iseddin n tkecmeḍ-is/taɣawsa-s n uḍebsi, ssarem taɣawsa-nni. 2. Xdem wussan d lweqt. 3. Ssebba Tḥumalit taḥeqqant, telli tiferra n usebter/tameẓla i d-yellan. 4. Qbel ma ilaq ad ttrajuḍ i imeɣnasen, ssebba-d talɣa n umennuɣ. 5. Rnu-t yerna ttɛerḍeḍ deg ṭṭaq n uḥassas i tzemreḍ ad tesɛuḍ.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday n uselkim. Ḥadret taswiɛt-is d taɣiwant-is akken iwata.
Mi ara d-yeɣli umezruy Synix yezmer ad yettraju imseqdacen i d-yeddun, dɣa ad yessaweḍ ad yeṭṭef taggayt n uḍebsi yettwaḥeqqaren, ad yeṭṭef taggayt mi ara yeṭṭef, ad isewweḍ, ad yernu ad d-yekkes akken i d-yefren tilelliyin.
Tameṭṭawt meqqren d taggara, mačči d lmeɛda ad nraju i lebda. Tzemreḍ ad teṭṭfeḍ tikli-nni mi d-teffeɣ, ɣas ma qqimen imurar. Lɛeṭṭa n zzerri ur d-tettak ara akud n ttraǧut.
Isebtaren n umseqdac: Ttrajun-nni teṭṭef ɣef tmusni i yezmer ad d-yefk uḥric yettwaferren. Asebtar n API i d-yeddukklen ɣer Satisfactory yettḥesbes tiɣriwin i d-yeffɣen neɣ ur d-yeffɣen ara s waṭas deg lweqt n ttrajda. Mačči d ayen i d-yeǧǧan iddaten n uselmed ur yettwaḥkem ara ad ilin s tidett.
Ssawḍ i imeɣnasen uqbel u ɣṛeḍ isallen n leqdic i d-yefkan. Isebtaren n Discord zemren ad d-nnan ayen i d-yettunefken deg uḥeddar mi ara d-yesseknen iberdan-nsen.
L'ordinateur doit être éveillé et le processus Synix pertinent doit être en cours d'exécution. Ur yezmir ara ad yexdem uselkim yettwaṭṭan neɣ yeṭṭes i uselkim n uselkim i d-yettunefkaren akken iwata.

data.value:
Abrid Windows Terminal neɣ PowerShell, tesqedceḍ asekkil n uḍebsi i d-yettunefkan. Tiḍebsiwin-a ttḥaddment Synix iman-is, mačči d iserweren n urar.
INSTALL winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
QQEL TAMURT-nni i d-yettwassen winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Aḍris Ssufeɣ Synix, tesqedceḍ axeddim-is uqbel ad tesxedmeḍ: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
QQEYEN TAMsalt winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Qqim iddaten-ik Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer taggara" Ur tterriḍ ara C:\Synix neɣ kra n yisekkilen n yedden i d-yettunefken, ala ma tebɣiḍ ad tterriḍ idden.
Ma yella kra n uselmed ur yessaweḍ ara Ɣeṛ ssebba-nni i d-yefkan. If WinGet d-yessawal yiwen n umseqdac ur yettemsefhamen ara s hash, ḥebseḍ ad t-id-tessawal; ur tɛezziḍ ara asmekti n hash. Asebtar amaynut yezmer ad d-yernu ma yella ur d-yessufeɣ ara aɣbalu amaynut.
WinGet approval and a matching download hash don't code-sign Synix or guarantee that Windows security software will trust it.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Qbel ad d-teḥeqqeḍ belli urar-nni ixeddem deg ubrid-ik. Tiɣriwin n uselkim ur zmiren ara ad d-sseklen urar ur yebni ara neɣ ur yefukk ara asekkil-is amezwaru.
XELSA TAMsirt IHEZZEN • Deg uselkim n uḍar: Sseqdec asmel n tlelli n umezgun yettwaɛǧeben neɣ n useqqamu n uḍar. • Deg usebter nniḍen n useqqamu n uxxam: Sseqdec-d tarrayt LAN n uselkim n uselkim. • Fuɣen n rrbeḥ-ik: Sseqdec asmel i d-yettunefkan i medden neɣ s uselmed n useḍfar/tameɣra i yettwaḥkem deg urar.
Isebtaren i yellan ddaw-a sɛan aseɣwen: Adres LAN privat ur yezmir ara ad t-sqedcen srid imseqdacen n Internet.
TEST LOCALLY 1. Ḥerǧu ad yekfu wurar. 2. Ẓer taqqimt i d-yettunefk d isefra n uselmed n uselkim. 3. Ɛeddi-d seg uselkim n uselkim, syin seg uselkim nniḍen n LAN. 4. Ma yella ur d-yettili ara tmeslayt n LAN, ẓer taggayt n uḍar d tmeslayt n Windows n usebter n tmeslayt i d-yettwaxedmen s tidet.
Ǧǧet imurar n Internet 1. Efk-as-d asmel n LAN yeṣṣan, s umata s usebter DHCP. 2. Issin-d tiwwura i yettwaḥwaǧen d yizerfan n TCP/UDP i umennuɣ n wurar s tidet. 3. Rnu-d kan tiɣriwin-nni n taggara ɣer usebter n LAN n umɛellem. 4. Ǧǧet ad d-yeffɣen tiɣriwin n urar s Windows Firewall deg imeslayen n tkebbanit i tesqedceḍ. 5. Aḍris seg yiwet n tdukli n Internet s tidet.
Ur t-id-yessuffu ara yiwen n uselkim n DMZ, ur t-id-yessuffu ara uḍebsi n tmeslayin, neɣ ur d-tessuffuḍ ara yal taɣiwant tadelsant am uguren ameqqran. Ɣur-ak isekkilen n uselkim.
Synix d amseqdac n usebter n useqdec. Ur tesɛi ara tafellat n web i yettwaḥebsen neɣ aselway ameqqran i d-yeǧǧan tiɣriwin-agi n tkebbanit.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD yettuɣalen d tayeḍ-nni n ifayilen n uselkim yexeddmen i uraren Steam i yettwasemmalen. Synix yettwaḥseb adlis-is i d-yeddukklen s ttawil; Asebtar amaynut ur yeḥwaǧ ara tab n SteamCMD.
ḌEH TAMsirt Iqedsen Select the server, read Activity & Diagnostics. Taɣawsa n useqqamu tettban-d d axeddim n usebded yettkemmil. SteamCMD yezmer ad yessuqel gar uḍegger, usebter, unpacking, d uḍegger, s wakka tiɣri-ines ur d-tettaf ara yal tikkelt yiwen n uzgen neɣ yiwen n wakud yesɛan laman.
Ǧǧet leqdic n uḍar ad yekfu ɣas ma yeɣli uḥeddim n useqqamu. Aql-d isallen n umenzu neɣ n ccɣel uqbel ad tebduḍ tikli nniḍen.
Aḥric n tezɣit n usebtar Open Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Select the supported limited mode and enter the displayed rate, neɣ select full speed.
D aya i d-yettunefken tiɣriwin n SteamCMD, mačči d tafaska n uḍar n imseqdacen, d umseqdac ur nelli ara d Steam n yal urar, neɣ d akayad akk deg uselkim.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday Kra n timura n wurar ttwaḥwaǧen yiwen n uḥric Steam yettunefk uselkem d tsertit n Steam Guard. Use Synix's sign-in prompt; Ur tettaǧǧan ara tiɣriwin n uselmed deg yisaruyen neɣ isallen i d-yettunefkan i medden.
Akken ad d-tessuffuḍ, ɣṛeḍ amḍal n SteamCMD akken iwata, ẓer amḍiq n diski yeffɣen, azruf n tfaska, azruf n uẓar, d ayen akk i ttwaḥwaǧen. Ad d-yeqqel uḍebsi n idlisen i d-yettunefken umseqdac, ihi ḥadret tizmeddin i d-yettunefken uqbel ad t-teqdec.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Imeslayen n Empyrion d yimedyazen n uḍris n uselkim n uselkim mgaraden. Di Serveur Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, select Empyrion scenarios or Empyrion server mods. Ḥebseḍ aselkim-nni, ḥadret aselkim n uselkim akk uqbel ad txedmeḍ timeddal.
INSTALL A SCENARIO 1. Browse Catalog yeldi Steam Workshop. Subscribe to the scenario and wait until Steam finish downloading it. Isebtaren i sɛan azday d isekkilen ur llin ara d iskenariyen n umseqdac. 2. Ffer Aḍebsi n Usekcem, syin Ffer Afaylu. Ffer afaylu n tegnit deg ufaylu-inek Steam n temkerḍit steamapps\workshop\content\383120 Aḍebsi. Tzemreḍ daɣen ad d-tefkeḍ kra n tegnit ZIP. 3. Err isem n tfaska n usarag yettwasnen. Ur ttqeddmeḍ ara kan asekkil n uselmed n tmeslayt. Ḥadret isem-nni n useqdec akken i d-yeffɣen iswiḍen. 4. Ass-a ad d-yesseqdec aseqdec n lbaṭel akked usebter, dɣa ad yefk tasekra i usebter. Synix tesekker tasensayt tamellalt ɣer Content\Scenarios ur tt-id-yessnulfu ara neɣ ur tbeddil ara ddunit. 5. Ffer Scenario i wumuɣ n yisenfaren i d-yettwasbedden. Fren yiwen seg-sen u ɛawed isem-nni n useḥbiber. Asekles ɣer yiwen uskenyar amaynut yessefk isem amaynut ur yettwasqedcen ara; Synix d win i d-yessugiren, yerna ur d-yettaǧǧa ara isefka yellan. 6. Sseqdec-d tagrawla, ssnulfuɣ aserwer, ẓṛeḍ adlis-is d tdukli n uselkim. Llan kra n yisensayen i d-yettunefkan tiɣriwin neɣ iḥwaǧen nniḍen i d-yefkan umaru-nsen.
Isem n usarag d GameConfig.CustomScenario; Isem n ddunit yettwasellek d GameConfig.GameName. Synix yettbeddil ɣer dedicated.yaml uqbel ad ibeddel isennanen-a yerna yeṭṭef taɣawsa n uselkim di tmucuha. Ur d-yeqqel ara tiɣriwin, imeslayen, neɣ isebtaren ur nezmiren ara.
INSTALL SERVER MODS Sseqdec amaru n yimeslayen n Empyrion d usebter n uḍegger n usebter akken ad tefrun amaruz ZIP n umeslay neɣ amaruz amaruz. Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut _Info.yaml mi ara d-yefk. Synix yessers-iten ddaw n Content\Mods; Adlis-nni ad d-yessufu amaru mi yebda. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Aɣmis"
Synix ur d-yettunefki ara amḍebber n mod neɣ ur d-yettunefki ara amḍebber n mod s ttawil. Ḍef-d ayen i d-yeǧǧan umaru, deg-s ula d yiwen n uḍebsi, amkan, d uselmed n umsuɣil. Taɣawsa n usebter ur d-tban ara belli amedya yettemsefhamen d uḍar n umedya neɣ d imeddyaḍen nniḍen i d-yettunefkan.
TAMURT D TAMURT Steam yessuffeɣ adlis-is n tmeslayt, mačči d adlis n uselkim i d-yessuffeɣ Synix. Akken ad d-tessuffuḍ, ḥebseḍ uselkim yerna tesseqceḍ amussu yettwasuffuḍ s usemmi n useqdec n useqdec. Ẓer ma yeḥwaǧ umaru-nni ad d-yeḥrez. Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usefru: ad d-yessuffeɣ yiwen n usebter ur d-yeqqil ara s tikli, yerna ur yettfeffer ara ifaylen i yeǧǧan deg ugraw amaynut.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usefru n isekkilen, mačči ɣef yal aɣbalu. Yessers (ur yettwaɛerḍu ara) yeɛni yettwaḥseb usefru, mačči d akken yal adlis yesers yettwaɛerḍu tikkelt nniḍen. Roll Back Import yeqqel tiɣriwin akk i d-yettwassnen, gar-asen imuddiyen nniḍen deg yiwet n terbaɛt, yerna yegguma ad yerr ifayilen yettbeddlen di beṛṛa n Synix. Isebtaren i sɛan azday d isallen n usarag yettwaḥwaǧen i tmura i yettwasellekten ttwaḥebsen seg usekkil; yiwen n usebter i d-yettwaṭṭfen yezmer ad d-yeqqel ɣer yidlisen-is imezwura.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Abrid Configure → Network & RCON akken ad d-teẓreḍ tifinin n taggara i d-yettunefken urar. Sseqdec asebter n wurar s tidet, mačči d asebter amaynut n yifiran.
ROLES DE PORT • Taɣawsa n wurar: Taɣawsa n imeɣnasen. • Tawwurt n useqdec: Isallen n uselkim neɣ usemmiḍ, ma yella yettwaḥemmel amaru-nni n useqdec. • RCON/admin port: Amkan n uselmed amatu. • Tawwurt App/API: Aḥeddad neɣ axeddim n uselmed i d-yellan ɣef urar.
TCP d UDP d imeslayen yemgaraden. Sin n tmeslayin yemgaraden zemren ad ssqedcen yiwen n uṭṭun n tmeslayit, maca sin n uselkimen ur zmiren ara ad msefhamen s kra n tmeslayin i d-yekkaten. Synix tesɛu ula d imeslayen yettwaḥebsen ɣef temsaltin n tmeslayin, gar-asen isekkilen i yeṭṭfen.
Ḥadret tiɣriwin n taggara i d-yettunefken d tin yezga i yiḍrisen, yerna ḥadret ayen akk i d-yeḥwaǧen deg urar gar tbexsanin. Ur ttxemmimeḍ ara belli amaru-nni akk d UDP neɣ belli yal amkan n tsertit yettwakalen aselmed n tidet.
TAMURT mačči d ccɣel Imurar ur ḥwaǧen ara ad sɛun azruf ɣer RCON neɣ yiwen n usebter nniḍen n uselmed. Ḥadret taswiɛt n uselmed deg umkan ma yella ur tesɛiḍ ara unagraw n uselmed i d-yettunefken seg ubrid.
ICEWWEN-IZZZEN • Minecraft Java d Bedrock ttxeddmen tikli n useqqamu; Ḍef abrid i d-yefren. • Satisfactory local API uses its configured game/API port; Taɣawsa-s n uḍris n uselmed ur d-tettawi ara azal i Synix. • Isebtaren i d-yettunefken deg tmeslayt n Dune, ttwakksen amaru n RMQ-s, mačči d axeddim n tmeslayt n Steam A2S. • Rust+ yessexdem amḍiq-is n taggara i d-yeddukklen akken ad d-yernu.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Template defaults" Ttxil-k i umeslay n tidet uqbel ad tbeddleḍ yiwen n uḍris n tmeslayt.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening yettqeddim aselmed n useqdec n umseqdac ameqqran. Ilaq ad d-yettunefk usebter n Hyper-V d hardware, yerna ilaq ad yettunefk Windows Pro neɣ Enterprise. Deg unebdu amezwaru, Synix yebda battlegroup.bat d amseqdac. Select initial-setup ad d-tessewweḍ asekkil-ik. Synix yezmer ad yers, ad yernu, ad yeqqel backups, ad d-yessuffeɣ, maca urar-nni i yesɛan tmacint n umwiru akked tegnit-nsen. data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks ttarun isefra n uselkimen i d-yettunefken ɣer yiwet n tmeslayt. D isebtaren, mačči d robot Discord i uselkim seg ubrid n Synix.
QQEL TAMURT 1. Asebter neɣ ad d-yawi aseqqamu n uḍar i tesɛiḍ tazmert ad t-tesseqdec. 2. Abrid n usebter yettwaferran n Uselmed → Discord. 3. Select the webhook and select the event routing options. 4. Ɣur-s asebter. 5. Sseqdec yiwet n tneḍra ma yella tettunefk-as, neɣ tesɛu ad d-tefkeḍ deg umezgun yettwaɣalen.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday n usebter, n usekkil, n usekkil, n uḍebsi, d uḍebsi, ttwaxedmen ɣef iberdan i d-yesseknen akked ma yella lxedma yeḍra s tidet.
QQEL TAMURT-nni Taɣnit n webhook tesɛa taggayt n usebtar. Win i tt-yettunefkan, yezmer ad d-yerr isalan ɣer tmeslayt-nni. Ḥebseḍ-t ɣef tmeslayin i d-yettwaṭṭfen, n usebter, n tsekla, d imeslayen.
Synix yeḥrez webhook-is yettwasellek i umseqdac n Windows. Ma yella d URL i d-yeffɣen, rnu-t deg Discord neɣ sseffɣen-t, imir-nni ad d-yessuffeɣ azref n Synix. Ẓer ismawen n uselkim d tiɣriwin n umedya i d-yessersen ɣer yiwen n uḍar yettwaseqdacen.
Ma ur d-tuɣalent ara isefra Ẓer abrid n umezgun i d-yefren, URL-nni, usefru n tlelli/tameẓla n web, d ma yezmer ad d-yuweḍ PC-nni ɣer Discord. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ur d-yessuffeɣ ara URL-nni akk.
Isebtaren ttqeddmen yiwet n tlelli i d-iteddun ɣer Discord. Ur ttwaḥwaǧent ara ad d-ffɣen tiwwurt n uselkim n umseḍar i d-yetteddun.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Qbel ma tzemreḍ ad teffɣeḍ kan tabutt n uselkim neɣ ad teffɣeḍ ula d iserwer-ik i d-yettunefken. D lecɣal yemgaraden.
Sseffɣen kan asmel 1. Ssexdem ayen akk i d-yettunefken, i d-yettunefken neɣ i d-yettunefken. 2. Qebbel imseqdacen-ik s Synix, ttraǧu ad d-fɣen deg usellek, dɣa ffɣemt si Synix. 3. Ɣur-k ad tesɛuḍ taktiwin n tmura meqqren, idlisen n uselmed, d isekkilen. 4. Ssufeɣ-d Synix s Windows Isebtaren i d-yessersen neɣ amseqdac-inek.
Ɣur-k C:\Synix, tiɣriwin n umseqdac i d-yettunefken, isefra n urar i d-yettunefken, d imukan n useqdec ma tebɣiḍ ad ten-txedmeḍ din. Ad d-yessuqel uselmed ur yeḥwaǧ ara ad tfeffeḍ isekkilen-agi.
Sseffɣet yiwen n uselkim Sseqdec taggayt n uselkim yettwaferren deg Synix, u ɣṛeḍ aseqqamu. Aḥeṭṭil n usebter n tneḍra ur d-yeqqel ara d ad t-id-tessefhem ad tfeǧǧeḍ ifaylen n tseddurt neɣ tiɣriwin n umennuɣ. Ẓer s ṣṣeḥ acḥal n yeddan ara yettwaḥseb.
Ur ttqeddmeḍ ara tnefsit d amḍiq n tuffra. Asebtar n yedru i d-yettunefken kan deg yiwen n tfaska i d-tesseffɣeḍ mačči d tikli n uselmed.
Ma yella tettbeddleḍ ɣer uḍebsiḍen n uselkim, ttkel-d akken yezmer ad d-yessnulfu tawsit akken iwata yerna ad d-yesseqdec umaḍal yettwaferra uqbel ad tessufeɣ iddat-ik iqburen.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Xtir aselkim, sqedceḍ tiɣawsiwin-is n ujerred neɣ tiɣawsiwin n urar ma llan. Synix ittefren tiɣawsiwin ɣef leḥsab n tsutert yettwaḥerzen deg urar, TCP/UDP/HTTP, API taɣelnawt, d tzemmar n usenfaṛ.
D acu i d ssebba Tiddukla n useqqamu n yizerfan ur d-tesbeggin ara belli umennay yezmer ad yesɛu tazeɣt yerna ad yeddukel. Ula d yiwen n uḍebsi n tudert ur d-yettban ara belli uselmed-is n tsertit yella yeṣfan.
Aṭṭas n imdanen d yisem n imdanen d izerfan yeṣfan. Amseqdac yezmer ad d-yernu acḥal n imdanen i yettuneqqlen, ur d-yessekcem ara isem n yimedyazen. Asebtar yečča mačči d yiwen n umenɣi i d-yesseknen.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtar i sɛan azday ɣer " Kra n yimeslayen n EOS kan neɣ n tmeslayin ur d-yefken ara taswiɛt i yettwaḥasben neɣ uḍar n uselmed n imseqdacen. Synix yezmer ad d-yessken N/A neɣ ad yeǧǧ aneskar am wakken ad d-yessken aswir yessewhamen.
Ẓer asekkil i d-yettwassen d uḍar n uselkim i d-yesseknen ɣef Minecraft. Satisfactory ad d-yeḥesben imseqdacen ɣef umkan-is API connection. Ur d-tefkiḍ ara tiɣriwin n EOS i yessawalen kan imseqdacen akken ad tesɛuḍeḍ tikti.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " SERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS " Aṭas n wurar n Steam i yettqeddmen tiɣriwin n A2S, maca aya mačči d tamaneɣt. Asmel, tiɣriwin n urar, d uselmed n useqdec yettḥulfan i tmuɣli, yerna ulac lweqt i d-yettunefk akken ad d-yettunefk.
Ma yella yiwen n uselkim ur yelli deg usemmiḍ, ttɛerḍeḍ uselmed n tdukli tugarant n wurar-nni, u rnu taggara-s. Tbeddil n tmeslayin ur neqqlen ara i tikwal, yezmer ad d-yewwin iɣeblan nniḍen.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Use Configure for Common Fields Synix manages. Sseqdec amedyaz n usefru n useqqamu deg Tiɣriwin n Uselkim mi ara d-teẓreḍ neɣ ad tbeddleḍ aseqqamu n wurar s tidet.
1. Ḥebseḍ aselkim ma yeɣra amaru-nni mi ara d-yessnulfu neɣ ad t-id-yesseqdec mi ara d-yeddu. 2. Efk-d asebter n uḍebsi, tesɛuḍ ad d-tesmektiḍ aserwer d usefru i d-yefren. 3. Ɣeṛ tiɣriwin d inebgawen i yellan. 4. Beddel kan tilelliwin i tebɣiḍ ad tbeddleḍ. 5. Ssefk ad d-tesseffuḍ tiɣriwin n umedyaz n uselmed, yerna rnu-d tiktiwin-is. 6. Ssellek, ssnulfu-d uselkim s Synix, dɣa ẓer taggayt taneggarut n wurar.
IYEN-YEBBEN Synix tesseqdec-d usebter n tmeslayt i yizerfan n INI/iseddin, JSON, XML, YAML, d tifsirin-nniḍen i yettwassnen. Mačči akk idlisen neɣ tiktiwin i yesɛan amedyaz yettwaselmen. YAML editing yesɛa taggayin yettwaḥesben, isekkilen yettwaḥesben, d tiɣawsiwin n yiwet n taɣawsa mi ara d-teddun timsirin d usekkil. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "YAML"
Ɣur-k tiɣriwin n usebter, tiɣriwin i yettwassen, ismawen n tkartiwin, d tmeslayin akken i ten-yettraju wurar. Ur ten-tessuqleḍ ara akken ad ttekcem ɣer tutlayt n tmeslayt.
TAMsirt ur d-tettɛawed ara Asebtar yeṣfan akken ilaq mazal yezmer ad yesɛu tilelliyin ur neqqlin ara. Mods neɣ imaynuten n wurar zemren ad rnu tiferriwin ur t-id-yettwalin ara umedyaz. Ttxil-k ad d-tiniḍ belli urar-nni yeččuṛ idlis akk-d umaḍal mi ara d-yessnulfu.
Ma yella amedyaz nniḍen neɣ urar yettbeddil afaylu-nni mi yella d amecṭuḥ, rnu-t-id s tikelt-nniḍen u qbel ad teffer. Isebtaren i sɛan azday amaynut rnu-tent, rnu-tent uqbel ad tt-rnuɣ.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer Satisfactory API qqimen deg Umezruy-is n uselkim, yerna llan ferkan seg usebter n idlisen n uselkim-is deg uḍar.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Select Configure for an existing server, or use the setup window while creating one. Beddel kan isennayen i d-yeffɣen deg urar-ik.
Askar aḥerfi d uskar unnig Ameddud n tebdawt yefka-d tazmert i tneṣsiwin n umezgun d uselmed n usebtar. Taɣawsa tamaynut tessekker-d tilelliyin tineggura, gar-asen RCON i yettwasemmaren d tilelliyin n tmeslayin. Asmi ara d-yedduklen tilelli ur tessuffɣen ara tiɣriwin i yettwassen. Isebtaren n Discord llan di snat n tegnatin.
D acu i d-yeṭṭfen yal asmel • Tameɣra: Isem n umseqdac, urar, edition/version, d yiferriyen i yettwaṭṭfen deg usaru. • Tazmert: Isebtaren n uḍris d isebbaḍen nniḍen n uḍris yettunefken s useqdec. • Tazrawt n umaḍal: Isem n umaḍal, tizzayt, amḍiq, d timsal n umaḍal i d-yeffɣen. • Tiddukla & RCON: Tiddukla n urar, taswiɛt, ameddakel/API, d tiɣriwin n taggara. • Taseqdec: Asebtar n yedru/taseqdec-d deg tazwara d useqdec-nni yettwaɣalen. • Discord: Isebtaren i d-yettunefkan d ubrid n umezgun. • Install & Launch: Asmel n tsertit d tiktiwin n tsertit i yettwaḥdem.
Timura i d-yesseklen ɣef urar, d tiɣriwin. Aḥric yezmer ad yesɛu amḍiq-nni neɣ ur yesɛi ara tazmert; Ur d-yettawi ara tiɣawsiwin i d-yettunefken deg uselmed.
TAMURT ICEQLEN Isebtaren i sɛan azday → Isebtaren i d-yeḥwaǧen → Aseqdec → Asellek n uselkim
Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tawla n usebter" Mi ara yeɛḍben tilelliwin i yettwaḥwaǧen, Synix ad yeldi azgen 3 akken ad tzemreḍ ad d-tmuqel tifertiwin-ik, dɣa ad d-yekkes Save Server. Isebtaren i sɛan azday Ilaq ad d-tefreḍ ad tesellek iman-ik; tebda reviu werǧin tettili s ttawil. Ɣeṛ-d awal-nni n uḍar akken iwata mi ara d-yeḥwaǧ azal.
Mi ara d-tesseggim uselkim, ḥebseḍ-t d amezwaru ma yella tibeddil-nni tesɛa d ifayllaren neɣ tiferwin i d-yettwaɣaren deg uḍef n uselkim. Ad d-yeffɣeḍ Ameddal i usebter-is; ur d-yessaram ara belli amur yetteddu yeḍra-d tiɣriwin-nni. Rnu-t s Synix mi ara t-yeḥwaǧ wurar.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Open Configure → Automation i umseqdac yettwassnen akken ad d-yefren uxeddim i d-iḍerrun uqbel ad d-yettunefki.
Aɣil ɣer tazwara Sseqdec-d aya akken ad d-tessnulfu taserdut n uselkim yeqqimen uqbel ad d-yetteddu. Ssebba root n umennuɣ d useṭṭef n umennuɣ deg Imḍebbren → Amennuɣ.
Asebtar n usemmiḍ yebda yeǧǧa-d ad d-yesseqdec umussu amaynut. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Tafsa"
UPDATE ON START Sseqdec-d aya akken ad d-txedmeḍ asebter n usebter n uḍar i yettwaɛǧeb uqbel ad d-teffeɣ. Yessuffeɣ idlisen n uselkim n wurar, mačči d asumer Synix.
Asebtar n usebter mačči d aseggwas belli yal tazwara ad d-tḥudd idlisen. SteamCMD d umseqdac n wurar i d-yettxemmimen d acu i yeḥwaǧen.
TAZWILT TAMURRUT D TAMURRUT Aḥeddim n Validate i d-yettunefken ad yessewweṛ neɣ ad yeqqel ad d-yeldi iseflawen i d-yettunefken umseqdac. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " Ur ttxemmim ara i ifayles n umdan yeqqim dima ur d-yettili ara.
Ɛerḍeḍ-d tiktiwin-ik Ssarem isebtaren-nni, ssexdem aseqdec i d-yettwaqeblen. Ɣeṛ isefra n tɣawsiwin akken ad d-teqqneḍ, ad d-ternuḍ, ad d-tessuffuḍ. Aḥric-nni yeččuṛ ur d-yefki ara belli urar-nni yeṭṭef ddunit-is s lferḥ.
Efk-d amḍiq yeffɣen i usefru, imseggwasen, ifaylen n tallit, d urar i d-yessers. Ma d lxedma i d-yettbeddlen uqbel ad d-tessuffu, ttnadi ssebba-nni i d-yefkan, wala ad d-tessuffu yiwen n uselkim i d-yeffɣen deg Synix akken ad t-id-yekkes.

Sserreḍ urar-nni, dɣa tselleḍ Start deg Synix tikkelt nniḍen. Synix ad d-yessufeɣ ifayel i d-yettunefken s ttawil.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Abrid Tayri i uselkim yettwaferren uqbel ad d-yebdu tikkelt tamezwarut neɣ mi ara yeɣli kra. Yettaṭṭef tiḥeqqiwin i d-yettunefken amaru-nni, am tfalayin, iswiyen n umennuɣ, uselmed, amḍiq n uḍar, iɣeblan, talɣa n usenfar, d yisekkilen i d-yeqqnen.
Fhem ayen i d-yeḍran • Tayri: Ur d-tufiḍ ara ugur n uḥersiwen i d-yeffɣen. • Tameẓla: teɣṛet ayen i d-yefkan, dɣa kksen-d ma yella ilaq ad txedmem kra. • Yettwaḥbes: Ssefru-d temsalt i d-yefkan uqbel ad tkemmel.
Tayri ur ttekki ara s yiman-is deg yal asmir i d-yettunefken. Isebtaren i sɛan azday yettwaferren d tsertit-is.
Mi ara d-teffɣeḍ yiwen n usebter amaynut Asebtar amezwaru yezmer ad d-yekkes idlisen, ad yerr unṣib yettwaɛǧeb, ad d-yessufu amkan, ad yeṭṭef talwit n tmusni. Sseqdec aselmed n tazwara d Activity & Diagnostics, mačči ad t-tḥesbeḍ amennuɣ i d-yettunefken.
Kra n yidlisen ḥwaǧen yiwen n ughaḍ, n uḥeqq, neɣ n uselmed/tameɣra deg wurar uqbel ad d-yeqqlen kra. Sqedceḍ talɣa-nni deg wemkan i d-yeḥwaǧ uḥric-nni.
TAMURT n usemmiḍ Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer " Install, Start, Stop and Monitoring results record operations " Synix yeẓra. Ur yettwaḥeqqeq ara maḍi, yebɣa ad d-yili kra n uḍris i d-yettwaṭṭfen; Mačči d ayen i d-yennan belli ur yettwaḥseb ara.
Asebtar Ready neɣ aḥric n umkan yesɛan lɛali ur d-yefki ara azref n Internet, imeddukal yelhan, neɣ tasemmal akked yal aselkim. Ternu s uḍebsi n tdukli d ddunit i d-yettunefkan.

Synix Control Panel yettwaxleq s lxiṛ i taggayt n usebtar. Taɣawsa-nwen tettḥemmel ad d-tessuffuḍ tikwalin d timsal i d-yekkan!
Ccetkeḍ ɣef ṭṭaq yellan ddaw-a neɣ ccen aɣric n QR akken ad teldiḍ PayPal Asebtar n useqdec yettwaḥrez deg umseqdac-inek.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Asebtar n usefru yettwafren yettḥerrez idlisen deg tfaska n usefru-nni n usefru. Ẓer anda i d-yeḥrez uḍar-is uqbel ad t-tṣekleḍ.
Sseqdec-d ad d-ternuḍ 1. Ḥebseḍ aselkim-nni ɣer Synix u ttraǧu ad d-yeffeɣ usebter-is. 2. Select backup action in Server Options. 3. Ẓer taṣebḥit, anida i d-yettunefk, amḍiq yettwaḥseb, d amḍiq n diski i yellan. 4. Ass-d yerna ttrajuḍ ad ternuḍ. 5. Select Open Backup Folder to locate the archive. Ɣer-s asebter-is n lxiṛ.
TAMURT Taɣawsa-nni tesɛa amḍebber n tseddurt, mačči kan d amḍebber amecṭuḥ i d-yettunefken. Timura meqqren tezmer ad teḥwaǧ aṭas n wakud d umezruy.
Isebtaren deg AppData, Documents, unṣuf nniḍen, neɣ yiwen n uselkim ameẓyan i d-yettunefken deg urar yezmer ad yili di beṛṛa n useqdec-nni. Rnu-asent-tent ɣef tallalt s uselmed n wurar yettwaḥesben.
TAMURT D TAMURT Taɣawsa n uḍebsi tamaneɣt d C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups i k-yeǧǧan ad d-tefreḍ taɣawsa nniḍen, dɣa ad ternuḍ taggara n uḍebsi umeddukel.
Asebtar amaynut Tbeddil n uẓeṭṭa n usebter ur d-yettarra ara neɣ ur yettfeffer ara iɣraben yellan; Ẓer amkan-nni iqburen i usekkil aqdim.
Tiddukla tessufeɣ iɣraben imeqranen mi ara d-yekkes taḥeqqiḍt i d-yettunefk deg tallit n uḍebsi. Ḥadret iswiyen n tuɣalin i d-iteddun di beṛṛa n wemkan-nni.
Ɣer usemmam amaynut nniḍen i d-yettwaḥesben n tmura meqqren. Aḍar i d-yeffɣen yezmer ad yerẓen amserwer akk-d usebtar yettwaḥrez deg yiwen n uḍar-nni. ZIP n uselmed n useqdec n uḍebsi ur d-yettili ara s yiman-is d aseqqamu n VM neɣ n uselmed n yedlisen.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Ɣeṛ awal n Windows akken iwata uqbel ad tbeddeḍ d acu ara tbeddleḍ. Aḍris yettwaḥebsen, amur n usefru n idlisen, d tallit n umennuɣ i yeǧǧan, d timsal nniḍen.
SYNIX WILL NOT INSTALL OR OPEN Sseqdec asebter n uselmed neɣ amennuɣ n WinGet akken iwata ubidzz.Synix. Ma yella ad tbeddeḍ amaru i d-yettmeslayen ur d-yettunefk ara azruf, ḥebseḍ asmel n Synix s useqdec n ubrid-nni akken illan yerna ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen. Ttxil-k ad d-teẓreḍ azruf n tfaska d yisalan n uselkim n tɣellist ma yeqqim ugur.
Ur tterriḍ ara isefra n uselkim neɣ ur tterriḍ ara tilelli akken ad d-tessewweḍ.
SMARTSCREEN Aḥebbar n usemmiḍ yezmer ad d-yefken ugar n tinfa → Isebtar amaynut, s leḥsab n tsertit Windows. Tiɣri n tikti-nni ur d-yettban ara belli amḍiq yettbanen. Ẓer taṣebḥit taserdast, ẓer tmuɣli-nni uqbel ad d-ternuḍ.
CONTROL APP SMART Ayagi yezmer ad yeqbel app mi ur yezmir ara Windows ad d-yettak iman-is. Ur tesɛi ara yiwen n usebter n useqdec n uselmed i yettemcabin ɣer SmartScreen's Run akken ma yella. Ur tt-id-terriḍ ara izerfan n tɣellist n Windows akken ad d-teddunt kan Synix.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAILUR Ẓer tamsalt d usefru. Ur ilaq ara ad d-txemmimeḍ belli taḥsebt d tamettant n lekdeb, acku isem-is d Synix. SHA-256 hash yeqqanen yettwassnen amaru i d-yettunefken; ur d-yefki ara taggara neɣ ad d-yettunefk yiwen n uḍris.
Rnu tamsalt d uselmed n tkecmeḍ s tuffra n tɣawsiwin Ḥebseḍ tiɣriwin n umezruy neɣ ad teffɣeḍ tiɣriwin n useqdec n uselkim.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Sseqdec Settings → Backups akken ad d-tawiḍ/tekkseḍ Synix akk. Aya yemgarad ɣef usmel n yiwen n ufaylu yellan yakan.
Qqareḍ D acu i d-yeḥwaǧ ad yeffeɣ Taɣawsa-nni n usefru tesɛa azref ameqqran C:\Synix. Asebtar ameddal neɣ tiɣriwin n umennuɣ i d-yekkan sɣur-s, akk-d tiɣriwin n urar izedɣen, ḥwaǧen ad tt-id-xedmen ɣef yiman-nsen. Aru abrid-nsen uqbel ad d-nebdu. Tameẓla Windows tiɣriwin tezmer ad ten-yeḥwaǧen ula d asmi ara d-yettmeslayen ɣef tmeɣra n usikel.
TAMURT 1. Ḥebseḍ imseqdacen, ḥebseḍ asmi i d-yettunefken, tbeddeḍ, aked tiɣawsiwin. 2. Select encrypted or normal export. 3. Select a destination outside the source tree and review size and temporary space requirements. 4. Akken ad d-tessufuḍ usefru yefren, ḍfer asebtar n usefru amehzen yerna sser-it ɣef yiman-is. 5. Ḥerǧu ad yekfu aɣbel n .synixbackup, imir-n ttwaḥeqqeḍ.
XELSA TAMsirt IHEZZEN Taɣawsa yettwaferru tettḥelqi amussu-nni yerna tesɛa tazmalt n usebter n yisekkilen i d-yettunefken ɣer usekcum Windows n umkan.
Lfaru n umezruy ur yettwaferru ara. Isefra n wurar d idlisen yellan deg-s zedɣen yezmer ad d-yefken timselliyin. Asebtar n usefru n Windows ur t-yettunefki ara s yiman-is ad t-id-yesseqdec deg usebter nniḍen.
TAMURT 1. Qbel ad d-ternuḍ isallen n Synix i d-yeffɣen tura. 2. Ffkeḍ imeslayen n usebter/tḥeqqit n usebter d wten aɣbel i yettwaferran. 3. Efk-d awal n usefru ma ttwaḥwaǧen, tesɛuḍ-d tasertit. 4. Ass-nni, ẓer amḍiq i d-yettunefk, u rnu-d tiɣriwin. 5. Ilaq ad d-yefḍeḥ lḥal, ad d-yesseqdec, ad d-yekkes. 6. Ẓer iberdan n umseqdac, tiwwura, isefra, imukan n uḍebsi, d tmeslayin uqbel ad tebdu kra.
Isekkil-d Satisfactory s tikelt-is n wemkan neɣ tdukli yettwaḥesben ur d-teddid ara. Ɣur-k lbaṭel n tazwara d iddaten iqdimen alamma ttwaɛerḍent iserweren i d-yettunefken.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday n usebter: Ma ur d-yefki ara usefru neɣ usebter, ḥerrez tikli-nni akked tmeslayt n tuɣalin am wakken ad tesbeddeḍ taserdast n yedlisen i yettwaxeddmen mi yella Synix yetteddu.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch yesɛa amaru n uselkim yettwafren d tiferwin n uselkim i tt-id-yettunefken. Ḥadret tazmert i d-yettunefken alamma tfehmeḍ tasensit n tmeslayt n wurar.
TAMURT TAMURT Seqdec talɣa taneggarut m'ara teḥwaǧeḍ isefka imɣuren. Ẓer isekkilen, iberdan n usegmi d yismawen n tefranin i d-yeḥwaǧ wurar. Synix yefka-d yakan imeslayen i yettwaḥerzen; Ma ternuḍ-d agejdan-iḍen, ad d-tawiḍ isebtar yemxalafen.
Ur tessuqleḍ ara isekkilen neɣ ur tessuqleḍ ara azal tecniḥt i yettwaǧun s usebter-is i d-yessuqel. Werǧin ad ternuḍ tiɣriwin i yiwen n uselmed kan akken ad ten-id-tesɛeddiḍ.
FILES de lancement exportées I yimedyazen i yettwaɛǧeb, Imtilelliyen n Serveur → Creat Batch File yettaru taggayt n uḍebsi i d-yesseklen ɣer yiwen n usaru.
Ad yesɛu adlis-nni izemren neɣ isekkilen n uxeddim akken ad yezmer ad d-yeddu ɣef yiman-is. Ḥadret-as s tidett, ṣeggem-t uqbel ad t-teqqareḍ neɣ ad t-terrem.
Ad d-yexdem amḍal n Synix ur d-yefki ara akk isekkilen n uxeddim n Synix, asdukkel n umeksa, tiɣriwin n usekles, neɣ uguren i d-yettunefk. Ur tt-id-tesseqdec ara ma yella Synix yakan yesɛa adlis-nni yetteddu.
IWENNEN IWENNEN Llan kra n yimeslayen n wurar i d-yessuffuɣen tilelliwin-nsen deg umkan n uselkim amecṭuḥ. Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer "Location" Sseqdec aselmed n wurar n umezgun, wala ad tesbedduḍ yiwen usebter amaynut neɣ usebter.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Sseqdec asebter n tlelli taserdast. Yettaf-d lweqt n usebded n .NET i yeḥwaǧ Synix; Isebtaren n wurar zemren mazal ad ḥwaǧen isefra-nsen.
XELSA TAMsilt n usebter • MSI: Tekkes-d SynixSetup.msi, tkecmeḍ-t, dɣa teldi Synix Control Panel seg menu Start. Amkan n useqdac n uselmed ameddal d %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Use the exact pack ubidzz.Synix. Asebtar n WinGet Taɣawsa d usebter yesɛan tilelliyin-nni. • Aḍebber n tmeslayt: Sseqceṛ-d asmel n uḍebber n tmeslayt n tmeslayt i d-yettunefken deg yiwen n useqqamu i yezmer ad yettaru, dɣa tesseqceṛ-it din. Aḥeddim n tmeslayt-nni ur d-yettili ara akk imseqdacen-ik.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
SSAYEN TAMsalt-nni 1. Sqedceḍ isebtaren i d-yettunefken, tessewweḍ, yerna tesɛuḍ. 2. Qebbel imseqdacen-ik n wurar s Synix, ḥebseḍ Synix akken ilaq. 3. Sseqdec amaynut neɣ asebter n usnas n usebded i d-tefkiḍ. 4. Efk-d Synix akken ad d-tḥeqqeḍ tiɣriwin d iberdan n uselkim-ik.
Ma yella tettbeddil tawsit tameqqrant n EXE s tawsit tameqqrant MSI, d amezwaru ad tessexdem tawsit tameqqrant. Ɣur-s iddaten n umseqdac-is d tdukliwin n umseqdac-is. Ur tterriḍ ara C:\Synix akken ad d-tḥerrez ugraw.
Asebtar n usebter ur d-yessuffeɣ ara timura i d-tessuffuḍ. Sseqdec-d taggayt n " Update " n uselkim i yettwaferren.
Ma d Windows i d-yettmeslayen asekkil yettwaḥbesken mi ara d-tesbeddu tmeslayt-nni, ẓer ma ur tetteddu ara tikli-nni i yettwasbedden. Ur ilaq ara ad d-ternuḍ tawsit yetteddun neɣ ad tessufuḍ iddaten n umseqdac akken ad txedmeḍ deg lxiṛ.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix yettɛeṭṭef tiɣri n uselmed uqbel ad d-tessuffuḍ kra n tmeslayin akken ad yeqqes uguren n uselmed. Ma yeṭṭef-d tazwara neɣ yeǧǧa-t, teɣṛet taluft n yedrimen i d-yefkan.
Qqim deg texxamt n win i d-yeṭṭfen Ad d-yeǧǧ tasemmirt i Windows d usebter n useqdec akked wurar. Ɣur-k amḍiq n diski akken ad d-teffɣeḍ timaynutin, idlisen n tallit, tiɣriwin, d isekkilen.
Aḥric n usmekti Minecraft i yettwassen yesɛan lxilaf deg uḍar-is/tamezzayt-is. Mačči d taḥriṭ taqbaylit i yal amussu i d-yessnulfan yal urar.
Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg taggayt CPU/RAM amḍan neɣ ad d-yeɛreḍ Windows Werǧin yezmer ad d-yeffeɣ yedrimen. Sseqdec asmel n uselmed d isebtaren n uḍar n pc akken ma llan i wakken ad tfehmeḍ taḥnuct n tidet.
NERWICK WARD Taɣawsa n usemmiḍ n tmeslayt n tkebbanit tettwalin tiḥawacen ur nelli ara n useqdec n tmeslayt/tmeslayin, yerna tesɛa azal ɣef lxedma n SteamCMD i yettwassen akken ad ɛeṭṭel tiɣawsiwin n lekdeb.
Mačči d tafyirt n tmeslayin, n usefru n ubrid, neɣ d uselmed n tɣellist DDoS. Ur d-yefki ara yiwen n win i d-yettwaṭṭfen neɣ ur d-yefki ara belli yeḍra-d yiwet n tegrest.
Mi ara t-id-yeḥseb, qbel leqdic-nni akked uḍebsiwin yettwassnen i d-yettunefken, i d-yedduklen akk-d uselmed nniḍen. Ttxil-k ad teẓreḍ tiɣriwin i d-yettunefken uqbel ad tbeddleḍ tiɣriwin n tɣellist neɣ n tkebbanit.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Select the Rust ad d-yesseqdec, ad yeẓer amḍiq-is, tidett-is, urar-is, tifyar-is, d imeddukal-is uqbel ad d-yebdu tazwara.
IDENTITÉ DU SERVER Synix yettunefk azal n +server.identity i yettwaɛǧeb seg tdukli n uselkim. Ḥadret tiɣriwin d tdukliyin i yisenfaren akken ur d-yeqqimen ara s wudem ur nesɛin amkan neɣ amkan.
RUST+ Ssebba-d yiwet n tmeslayt n useqdac i yettwasseldun i uselmed n useqdac, dɣa dduk talɣa n useqdac n Rust d uḥwaǧen n useqqamu. Taɣawsa-s n taggara tezga-d seg umussu n urar d uselmed n RCON.
Ẓer tiwwura i d-yeqqnen s tidet, wala ad d-tekkes yiwen n uḍris seg uselkim nniḍen n Rust. Ḥadret isekkilen n RCON, ur ten-tessufeɣ ara akken ad tɛawed medden ad kecmen.
VANILLA D OXIDE Vanilla tesseqdac idlisen n useqdec uselkim. S yiɣil n Oxide, yettunefk-d amḍal n uselmed n uselmed i d-yettwaṭṭfen ɣef yizerfan n Steam. Taɣawsa n useqdec ur tefrun ara neɣ ur teẓrin ara tifeṛḍin tineggura.
Seqdec axeddim anida i d-yettwasekles Mod & Plugin Manager i usebded n Oxide/uMod. Isekkilen mazal ḥwaǧen tiɣriwin yemsefhamen d yisenfaren yettwamnen.
Synix yesseqdec-d tallit n oxide i yettwasseldun mi ara d-yessuffeɣ neɣ ad d-yeḥdem Rust mi ara d-yettwafer unagraw-nni. Ma tebɣiḍ ad d-teqqel ɣer idlisen n Vanilla, beddle-d taggayt n uḍebsi n useqdec, tkecmeḍ uswir n leqdic n Update neɣ Validate i yettwassnen.
Qbel ad tbeddleḍ amḍiq neɣ ccna, ḥadret iddaten n umaḍal, n umennuɣ, d plugin. Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usefru: usebter n useqdec ur d-yettban ara belli yal addid yettunefken akken iwata.

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: ATLAS d yiwen n uselkim yettwaqqimen yerna ur yezmir ara ad d-yebdi ifayilen-a s uselkim n uselkim. Sseqdec ServerGridEditor n Grapeshot Games i wakken ad d-ternuḍ u ad tkecmeḍ tagrid. Cekkeḍ ServerGrid.json d ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json ɣer tfaska n ShooterGame n uselkim. Qbel ad d-tekcem ATLAS, ruḥ AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat uǧǧ Redis ad iteddu. Ad yeqqim Redis yeṭṭef ɣer 127.0.0.1; ur d-yefki ara taqqna 6379 i LAN, router neɣ Internet. Amedyaz agellid: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor
